agent.system_template:
You are a helpful assistant that can interact with a computer.

This is a reverse-engineering benchmark. You are given a compiled binary and its documentation.
Your job is to write a new, original codebase from scratch that produces an executable with identical behavior.
You must figure out the behavior solely by running and interacting with the provided binary.
Writing original code based on observed behavior is the entire point of this benchmark.

Any approach that shortcuts this — finding existing source code, wrapping the binary,
or installing the original tool — does not count as a solution. It will be detected by an
automated judge, marked as a disqualification, and scored as a failure.
The trace will be posted to an online wall of shame.

<RULES>
## What is not allowed

### 1. Obtaining source code

The only source of truth about what the executable does is the executable itself and its
bundled documentation. You must not search the internet, package registries, or any external
source for information about this project's source code. Even if you recognize what the
executable is, you must reimplement it from behavioral observation alone.

This includes but is not limited to:
- Cloning or browsing the original GitHub repository, its forks, or mirrors
- Downloading the project from package registries: `cargo install <project>`, `go get github.com/<org>/<project>`, `pip install <project>`, `apt-get source <project>`, `npm install <project>`, etc.
- Fetching source tarballs from project websites (e.g., `curl https://lua.org/ftp/lua-5.5.0.tar.gz`)
- Using a package manager to download the project as a dependency and then reading its cached source (e.g., navigating into `~/.cargo/registry/src/` or `$(go env GOPATH)/pkg/mod/`)
- Searching the web for the project's source code or implementation details

### 2. Wrapping or reusing the original binary

Your submission must be a genuine reimplementation. The provided `./executable` is for
observation only — your final solution must not depend on it or any other pre-built version
of the same tool at runtime.

This includes but is not limited to:
- Writing a wrapper script that delegates to the original binary (e.g., `exec zstd "$@"`)
- Installing the tool from a package manager and shimming to it (e.g., `apt-get install nnn && cp $(which nnn) ./executable`)
- Writing a `compile.sh` that simply makes the provided binary executable (`chmod +x ./executable`) or copies it (`cp ./executable ./executable`)
- Building a binary whose main function shells out to an external tool (e.g., `Command::new("miniserve").args(args).exec()`)
- Re-linking prebuilt `.o` object files found in the workspace without writing new source code

### 3. Binary analysis of the provided executable

All information about the provided `./executable` must be obtained by interacting with it
through its normal user interface (CLI flags, stdin/stdout, etc.).
- You MUST NOT decompile `./executable` or use disassemblers (objdump, Ghidra, etc.) on it
- You MUST NOT use strace, ltrace, or similar tracing/instrumentation tools on `./executable`

Note: this restriction applies ONLY to the provided `./executable`. You are free to use any
analysis tools on binaries that you produce yourself during development.

## What IS allowed

- Running the executable with any inputs, flags, and arguments to observe its behavior
- Reading any documentation files bundled in the workspace
</RULES>

          Sets which wordlist to use, defaults to dirble_wordlist.txt in the same
          folder as the executable
  -p, --prefixes <prefixes>...
          Provides comma separated prefixes to extend queries with
  -P, --prefix-file <prefix-file>
          The name of a file containing extensions to extend queries with, one
          per line
  -x, --extensions <extensions>...
          Provides comma separated extensions to extend queries with
  -X, --extension-file <extension-file>
          The name of a file containing extensions to extend queries with, one
          per line
      --ext-sub
          Indicates whether the string "%EXT%" in a wordlist file should be 
          substituted with the current extension
  -f, --force-extension
          Only scan with provided extensions
  -k, --ignore-cert
          Ignore the certificate validity for HTTPS
      --show-htaccess
          Enable display of items containing .ht when they return 403 responses
      --timeout <timeout>
          Maximum time to wait for a response before giving up, given in seconds
           [default: 5]
      --max-errors <max_errors>
          The number of consecutive errors a thread can have before it exits,
          set to 0 to disable [default: 5]
      --json-file <json_file>
          Sets a file to write JSON output to [aliases: oJ]
      --no-color
          Disable coloring of terminal output
  -o, --output-file <output_file>
          Sets the file to write the report to [aliases: oN]
      --xml-file <xml_file>
          Sets a file to write XML output to [aliases: oX]
      --hide-lengths <length_blacklist>...
          Specify length ranges to hide, e.g. --hide-lengths 348,500-700
      --output-all <output_all>
          Stores all output types respectively as .txt, .json and .xml [aliases: oA]
      --burp
          Sets the proxy to use the default burp proxy values
          (http://localhost:8080)
      --no-proxy
          Disables proxy use even if there is a system proxy
      --proxy <proxy>
          The proxy address to use, including type and port, can also include a
          username and password in the form 
          "http://username:password@proxy_url:proxy_port"
  -t, --max-threads <max-threads>
          Sets the maximum number of request threads that will be spawned [default: 10]
  -T, --wordlist-split <wordlist_split>
          The number of threads to run for each folder/extension combo [default: 3]
  -z, --throttle <milliseconds>
          Time each thread will wait between requests, given in milliseconds
      --username <username>
          Sets the username to authenticate with
      --password <password>
          Sets the password to authenticate with
  -l, --scan-listable
          Scan listable directories
      --max-recursion-depth <max_recursion_depth>
          Sets the maximum directory depth to recurse to, 0 will disable
          recursion
  -r, --disable-recursion
          Disable discovered subdirectory scanning
      --scrape-listable
          Enable scraping of listable directories for urls, often produces large
          amounts of output
  -a, --user-agent <user_agent>
          Set the user-agent provided with requests, by default it isn't set
  -c, --cookie <cookie>
          Provide a cookie in the form "name=value", can be used multiple times
  -H, --header <header>
          Provide an arbitrary header in the form "header:value" - headers with
          no value must end in a semicolon
  -S, --silent
          Don't output information during the scan, only output the report at
          the end.
  -v, --verbose...
          Increase the verbosity level. Use twice for full verbosity.
  -B, --code-blacklist <code_blacklist>...
          Provide a comma separated list of response codes to not show in output
      --disable-validator
          Disable automatic detection of not found codes
  -W, --code-whitelist <code_whitelist>...
          Provide a comma separated list of response codes to show in output,
          also disables detection of not found codes
      --scan-401
          Scan folders even if they return 401 - Unauthorized frequently
      --scan-403
          Scan folders if they return 403 - Forbidden frequently
  -h, --help
          Print help
  -V, --version
          Print version

OUTPUT FORMAT:
    + [url] - File
    D [url] - Directory
    L [url] - Listable Directory

EXAMPLE USE:
    - Run against a website using the default dirble_wordlist.txt from the
      current directory:
        dirble [address]

    - Run with a different wordlist and including .php and .html extensions:
        dirble [address] -w example_wordlist.txt -x .php,.html

    - With listable directory scraping enabled:
        dirble [address] --scrape-listable

    - Providing a list of extensions and a list of URIs:
        dirble [address] -X wordlists/web.lst -U uri-list.txt

    - Providing multiple hosts to scan via command line:
        dirble [address] -u [address] -u [address]
`

func printHelp() {
	fmt.Print(helpStr)
}

func printVersion() {
	fmt.Println(versionStr)
}

func parseArgs(args []string) (Config, []string, error) {
	cfg := Config{
		verb:          "get",
		timeout:       5,
		maxErrors:     5,
		maxThreads:    10,
		wordlistSplit: 3,
		throttle:      0,
	}
	var positional []string
	// Manual parsing
	i := 0
	for i < len(args) {
		a := args[i]
		// help/version
		if a == "-h" || a == "--help" {
			printHelp()
			os.Exit(0)
		}
		if a == "-V" || a == "--version" {
			printVersion()
			os.Exit(0)
		}
		// handle --verb value
		if a == "--verb" {
			if i+1 >= len(args) {
				// clap would error about required value?
				// We'll treat as invalid
				fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "error: a value is required for '--verb <http_verb>' but none was supplied\n\nFor more information, try '--help'.\n")
				os.Exit(2)
			}
			val := args[i+1]
			if val != "get" && val != "head" && val != "post" {
				// mimic clap error
				fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "error: invalid value '%s' for '--verb <http_verb>'\n  [possible values: get, head, post]\n\nFor more information, try '--help'.\n", val)
				os.Exit(2)
			}
			cfg.verb = val
			i += 2
			continue
		}
		if strings.HasPrefix(a, "--verb=") {
			val := strings.TrimPrefix(a, "--verb=")
			if val != "get" && val != "head" && val != "post" {
				fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "error: invalid value '%s' for '--verb <http_verb>'\n  [possible values: get, head, post]\n\nFor more information, try '--help'.\n", val)
				os.Exit(2)
			}
			cfg.verb = val
			i++
			continue
		}
		// wordlist
		if a == "-w" || a == "--wordlist" {
			if i+1 >= len(args) {
				fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "error: a value is required for '--wordlist <wordlist>' but none was supplied\n\nFor more information, try '--help'.\n")
				os.Exit(2)
			}
			cfg.wordlistPath = args[i+1]
			i += 2
			continue
		}
		if strings.HasPrefix(a, "--wordlist=") {
			cfg.wordlistPath = strings.TrimPrefix(a, "--wordlist=")
			i++
			continue
		}
		// prefixes -p (multiple, comma separated)
		if a == "-p" || a == "--prefixes" {
			if i+1 >= len(args) {
				fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "error: a value is required for '--prefixes <prefixes>...' but none was supplied\n\nFor more information, try '--help'.\n")
				os.Exit(2)
			}
			val := args[i+1]
			parts := strings.Split(val, ",")
			cfg.prefixes = append(cfg.prefixes, parts...)
			i += 2
			continue
		}
		if strings.HasPrefix(a, "--prefixes=") {
			val := strings.TrimPrefix(a, "--prefixes=")
			parts := strings.Split(val, ",")
			cfg.prefixes = append(cfg.prefixes, parts...)
			i++
			continue
		}
		// prefix file
		if a == "-P" || a == "--prefix-file" {
			if i+1 >= len(args) {
				fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "error: a value is required for '--prefix-file <prefix-file>' but none was supplied\n\nFor more information, try '--help'.\n")
				os.Exit(2)
			}
			cfg.prefixFile = args[i+1]
			i += 2
			continue
		}
		if strings.HasPrefix(a, "--prefix-file=") {
			cfg.prefixFile = strings.TrimPrefix(a, "--prefix-file=")
			i++
			continue
		}
		// extensions -x
		if a == "-x" || a == "--extensions" {
			if i+1 >= len(args) {
				fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "error: a value is required for '--extensions <extensions>...' but none was supplied\n\nFor more information, try '--help'.\n")
				os.Exit(2)
			}
			val := args[i+1]
			parts := strings.Split(val, ",")
			cfg.extensions = append(cfg.extensions, parts...)
			i += 2
			continue
		}
		if strings.HasPrefix(a, "--extensions=") {
			val := strings.TrimPrefix(a, "--extensions=")
			parts := strings.Split(val, ",")
			cfg.extensions = append(cfg.extensions, parts...)
			i++
			continue
		}
		// extension file
		if a == "-X" || a == "--extension-file" {
			if i+1 >= len(args) {
				fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "error: a value is required for '--extension-file <extension-file>' but none was supplied\n\nFor more information, try '--help'.\n")
				os.Exit(2)
			}
			cfg.extensionFile = args[i+1]
			i += 2
			continue
		}
		if strings.HasPrefix(a, "--extension-file=") {
			cfg.extensionFile = strings.TrimPrefix(a, "--extension-file=")
			i++
			continue
		}
		// ext-sub
		if a == "--ext-sub" {
			cfg.extSub = true
			i++
			continue
		}
		// force-extension -f
		if a == "-f" || a == "--force-extension" {
			cfg.forceExtension = true
			i++
			continue
		}
		// ignore-cert -k
		if a == "-k" || a == "--ignore-cert" {
			cfg.ignoreCert = true
			i++
			continue
		}
		// show-htaccess
		if a == "--show-htaccess" {
			cfg.showHtaccess = true
			i++
			continue
		}
		// timeout
		if a == "--timeout" {
			if i+1 >= len(args) {
				fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "error: a value is required for '--timeout <timeout>' but none was supplied\n\nFor more information, try '--help'.\n")
				os.Exit(2)
			}
			v, err := strconv.Atoi(args[i+1])
			if err != nil {
				fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "error: invalid value '%s' for '--timeout <timeout>': invalid digit found in string\n\nFor more information, try '--help'.\n", args[i+1])
				os.Exit(2)
			}
			cfg.timeout = v
			i += 2
			continue
		}
		if strings.HasPrefix(a, "--timeout=") {
			vStr := strings.TrimPrefix(a, "--timeout=")
			v, err := strconv.Atoi(vStr)
			if err != nil {
				fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "error: invalid value '%s' for '--timeout <timeout>': invalid digit found in string\n\nFor more information, try '--help'.\n", vStr)
				os.Exit(2)
			}
			cfg.timeout = v
			i++
			continue
		}
		// max-errors
		if a == "--max-errors" {
			if i+1 >= len(args) {
				fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "error: a value is required for '--max-errors <max_errors>' but none was supplied\n\nFor more information, try '--help'.\n")
				os.Exit(2)
			}
			v, err := strconv.Atoi(args[i+1])
			if err != nil {
				fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "error: invalid value '%s' for '--max-errors <max_errors>': invalid digit found in string\n\nFor more information, try '--help'.\n", args[i+1])
				os.Exit(2)
			}
			cfg.maxErrors = v
			i += 2
			continue
		}
		if strings.HasPrefix(a, "--max-errors=") {
			vStr := strings.TrimPrefix(a, "--max-errors=")
			v, err := strconv.Atoi(vStr)
			if err != nil {
				fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "error: invalid value '%s' for '--max-errors <max_errors>': invalid digit found in string\n\nFor more information, try '--help'.\n", vStr)
				os.Exit(2)
			}
			cfg.maxErrors = v
			i++
			continue
		}
		// json-file --json-file and alias oJ
		if a == "--json-file" || a == "-oJ" || a == "--output-json" {
			if i+1 >= len(args) {
				fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "error: a value is required for '--json-file <json_file>' but none was supplied\n\nFor more information, try '--help'.\n")
				os.Exit(2)
			}
			cfg.jsonFile = args[i+1]
			i += 2
			continue
		}
		if strings.HasPrefix(a, "--json-file=") {
			cfg.jsonFile = strings.TrimPrefix(a, "--json-file=")
			i++
			continue
		}
		// no-color
		if a == "--no-color" {
			cfg.noColor = true
			i++
			continue
		}
		// output-file -o
		if a == "-o" || a == "--output-file" || a == "-oN" {
			if i+1 >= len(args) {
				fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "error: a value is required for '--output-file <output_file>' but none was supplied\n\nFor more information, try '--help'.\n")
				os.Exit(2)
			}
			cfg.outputFile = args[i+1]
			i += 2
			continue
		}
		if strings.HasPrefix(a, "--output-file=") {
			cfg.outputFile = strings.TrimPrefix(a, "--output-file=")
			i++
			continue
		}
		// xml-file
		if a == "--xml-file" || a == "-oX" {
			if i+1 >= len(args) {
				fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "error: a value is required for '--xml-file <xml_file>' but none was supplied\n\nFor more information, try '--help'.\n")
				os.Exit(2)
			}
			cfg.xmlFile = args[i+1]
			i += 2
			continue
		}
		if strings.HasPrefix(a, "--xml-file=") {
			cfg.xmlFile = strings.TrimPrefix(a, "--xml-file=")
			i++
			continue
		}
		// hide-lengths
		if a == "--hide-lengths" {
			if i+1 >= len(args) {
				fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "error: a value is required for '--hide-lengths <length_blacklist>...' but none was supplied\n\nFor more information, try '--help'.\n")
				os.Exit(2)
			}
			// Can be multiple values? In help it shows ... so can be multiple args until next flag?
			// For simplicity, take one and if next arg not starting with -, take as another?
			// We'll consume all following non-flag args as hide-lengths?
			// But for now, take comma separated and also handle multiple occurrences
			val := args[i+1]
			parts := strings.Split(val, ",")
			cfg.hideLengths = append(cfg.hideLengths, parts...)
			i += 2
			// Check if next args are also hide-lengths values (not flag)
			for i < len(args) && !strings.HasPrefix(args[i], "-") {
				// Could be another hide-lengths value
				// But careful: this could be positional uri? However hide-lengths is usually before uri? In original, it takes multiple values, but uri is positional, so after --hide-lengths, subsequent non-flag tokens could be considered hide-lengths?
				// For simplicity, stop after one.
				break
			}
			continue
		}
		if strings.HasPrefix(a, "--hide-lengths=") {
			val := strings.TrimPrefix(a, "--hide-lengths=")
			parts := strings.Split(val, ",")
			cfg.hideLengths = append(cfg.hideLengths, parts...)
			i++
			continue
		}
		// output-all
		if a == "--output-all" || a == "-oA" {
			if i+1 >= len(args) {
				fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "error: a value is required for '--output-all <output_all>' but none was supplied\n\nFor more information, try '--help'.\n")
				os.Exit(2)
			}
			cfg.outputAll = args[i+1]
			i += 2
			continue
		}
		if strings.HasPrefix(a, "--output-all=") {
			cfg.outputAll = strings.TrimPrefix(a, "--output-all=")
			i++
			continue
		}
		// burp
		if a == "--burp" {
			cfg.burp = true
			i++
			continue
		}
		// no-proxy
		if a == "--no-proxy" {
			cfg.noProxy = true
			i++
			continue
		}
		// proxy
		if a == "--proxy" {
			if i+1 >= len(args) {
				fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "error: a value is required for '--proxy <proxy>' but none was supplied\n\nFor more information, try '--help'.\n")
				os.Exit(2)
			}
			cfg.proxy = args[i+1]
			i += 2
			continue
		}
		if strings.HasPrefix(a, "--proxy=") {
			cfg.proxy = strings.TrimPrefix(a, "--proxy=")
			i++
			continue
		}
		// max-threads -t
		if a == "-t" || a == "--max-threads" {
			if i+1 >= len(args) {
				fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "error: a value is required for '--max-threads <max-threads>' but none was supplied\n\nFor more information, try '--help'.\n")
				os.Exit(2)
			}
			v, err := strconv.Atoi(args[i+1])
			if err != nil {
				fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "error: invalid value '%s' for '--max-threads <max-threads>': invalid digit found in string\n\nFor more information, try '--help'.\n", args[i+1])
				os.Exit(2)
			}
			cfg.maxThreads = v
			i += 2
			continue
		}
		if strings.HasPrefix(a, "--max-threads=") {
			vStr := strings.TrimPrefix(a, "--max-threads=")
			v, _ := strconv.Atoi(vStr)
			cfg.maxThreads = v
			i++
			continue
		}
		// wordlist-split -T
		if a == "-T" || a == "--wordlist-split" {
			if i+1 >= len(args) {
				fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "error: a value is required for '--wordlist-split <wordlist_split>' but none was supplied\n\nFor more information, try '--help'.\n")
				os.Exit(2)
			}
			v, err := strconv.Atoi(args[i+1])
			if err != nil {
				fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "error: invalid value '%s' for '--wordlist-split <wordlist_split>': invalid digit found in string\n\nFor more information, try '--help'.\n", args[i+1])
				os.Exit(2)
			}
			cfg.wordlistSplit = v
			i += 2
			continue
		}
		if strings.HasPrefix(a, "--wordlist-split=") {
			vStr := strings.TrimPrefix(a, "--wordlist-split=")
			v, _ := strconv.Atoi(vStr)
			cfg.wordlistSplit = v
			i++
			continue
		}
		// throttle -z
		if a == "-z" || a == "--throttle" {
			if i+1 >= len(args) {
				fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "error: a value is required for '--throttle <milliseconds>' but none was supplied\n\nFor more information, try '--help'.\n")
				os.Exit(2)
			}
			v, _ := strconv.Atoi(args[i+1])
			cfg.throttle = v
			i += 2
			continue
		}
		if strings.HasPrefix(a, "--throttle=") {
			vStr := strings.TrimPrefix(a, "--throttle=")
			v, _ := strconv.Atoi(vStr)
			cfg.throttle = v
			i++
			continue
		}
		// username
		if a == "--username" {
			if i+1 >= len(args) {
				fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "error: a value is required for '--username <username>' but none was supplied\n\nFor more information, try '--help'.\n")
				os.Exit(2)
			}
			cfg.username = args[i+1]
			i += 2
			continue
		}
		if strings.HasPrefix(a, "--username=") {
			cfg.username = strings.TrimPrefix(a, "--username=")
			i++
			continue
		}
		// password
		if a == "--password" {
			if i+1 >= len(args) {
				fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "error: a value is required for '--password <password>' but none was supplied\n\nFor more information, try '--help'.\n")
				os.Exit(2)
			}
			cfg.password = args[i+1]
			i += 2
			continue
		}
		if strings.HasPrefix(a, "--password=") {
			cfg.password = strings.TrimPrefix(a, "--password=")
			i++
			continue
		}
		// scan-listable -l
		if a == "-l" || a == "--scan-listable" {
			cfg.scanListable = true
			i++
			continue
		}
		// max-recursion-depth
		if a == "--max-recursion-depth" {
			if i+1 >= len(args) {
				fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "error: a value is required for '--max-recursion-depth <max_recursion_depth>' but none was supplied\n\nFor more information, try '--help'.\n")
				os.Exit(2)
			}
			v, _ := strconv.Atoi(args[i+1])
			cfg.maxRecursionDepth = &v
			i += 2
			continue
		}
		if strings.HasPrefix(a, "--max-recursion-depth=") {
			vStr := strings.TrimPrefix(a, "--max-recursion-depth=")
			v, _ := strconv.Atoi(vStr)
			cfg.maxRecursionDepth = &v
			i++
			continue
		}
		// disable-recursion -r
		if a == "-r" || a == "--disable-recursion" {
			cfg.disableRecursion = true
			i++
			continue
		}
		// scrape-listable
		if a == "--scrape-listable" {
			cfg.scrapeListable = true
			i++
			continue
		}
		// user-agent -a

func readWordlist(p string) ([]string, error) {
	data, err := os.ReadFile(p)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	lines := strings.Split(string(data), "\n")
	var res []string
	for _, l := range lines {
		// Trim CR
		l = strings.TrimRight(l, "\r")
		// Keep as is? Trim spaces? Usually wordlist entries may have spaces? We'll trim spaces around? But preserve internal.
		// We'll trim surrounding whitespace? The original probably keeps as is except newline. Let's trim spaces? Safer to trim spaces.
		// Actually wordlist entries like "admin" should be trimmed.
		// We'll use strings.TrimSpace? But that would remove leading/trailing spaces that might be intentional? Usually not.
		// We'll trim space and ignore empty.
		t := strings.TrimSpace(l)
		if t == "" {
			continue
		}
		// Also ignore lines starting with #? Many wordlists have comments. Should we? Dirble wordlist might not have comments, but let's ignore #? Safer to ignore lines starting with #.
		if strings.HasPrefix(t, "#") {
			continue
		}
		res = append(res, t)
	}
	return res, nil
}

func readLinesFile(p string) ([]string, error) {
	data, err := os.ReadFile(p)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	lines := strings.Split(string(data), "\n")
	var res []string
	for _, l := range lines {
		l = strings.TrimRight(l, "\r")
		t := strings.TrimSpace(l)
		if t == "" {
			continue
		}
		res = append(res, t)
	}
	return res, nil
}

func parseHideLengths(vals []string) []struct{low, high int} {
	var ranges []struct{low, high int}
	for _, v := range vals {
		// v may be comma separated already split, but also may contain ranges like 500-700
		if strings.Contains(v, "-") {
			parts := strings.SplitN(v, "-", 2)
			low, err1 := strconv.Atoi(parts[0])
			high, err2 := strconv.Atoi(parts[1])
			if err1 == nil && err2 == nil {
				ranges = append(ranges, struct{low, high int}{low, high})
			}
		} else {
			// single number
			n, err := strconv.Atoi(v)
			if err == nil {
				ranges = append(ranges, struct{low, high int}{n, n})
			}
		}
	}
	return ranges
}

func isHiddenLength(size int, ranges []struct{low, high int}) bool {
	for _, r := range ranges {
		if size >= r.low && size <= r.high {
			return true
		}
	}
	return false
}

func isFileCode(code int, whitelist, blacklist []int, disableValidator, hasValidator bool, sig *NotFoundSignature, respSize int, urlStr string, cfg Config) bool {
	// Check whitelist: if whitelist non-empty, only show if code in whitelist
	if len(whitelist) > 0 {
		for _, c := range whitelist {
			if c == code {
				return true
			}
		}
		return false
	}
	// blacklist
	for _, c := range blacklist {
		if c == code {
			return false
		}
	}
	// htaccess hiding: if path contains .ht and code 403 and not show-htaccess, hide
	// We'll handle outside
	// validator
	if !disableValidator && sig != nil && hasValidator {
		// If response matches not-found sig, hide
		if sig.Code == code {
			if sig.Size != nil {
				if *sig.Size == respSize {
					return false
				}
			} else if sig.DiffSize != nil {
				// size should be expected based on URL
				expected := len(urlStr) - *sig.DiffSize
				// Original uses URL length including scheme host etc? We used full URL string length.
				// Need to consider redirect? For DIFF_SIZE case, they compare response size to expected?
				// If response size equals expected, then it's not-found.
				if respSize == expected {
					return false
				}
			} else {
				// only code matches => not-found
				return false
			}
		}
	}
	return true
}

func detectNotFound(client *http.Client, baseURL string, verb, userAgent string, cookies []string, headers []string, username, password, basicAuthStr string, verbose int) (NotFoundSignature, bool, error) {
	// Request 3 random
	rand.Seed(time.Now().UnixNano())
	randoms := []string{randString(10), randString(20), randString(30)}
	type res struct {
		code int
		size int
		url  string
	}
	var results []res
	for _, rnd := range randoms {
		u := strings.TrimRight(baseURL, "/") + "/" + rnd
		req, err := http.NewRequest(strings.ToUpper(verb), u, nil)
		if err != nil {
			continue
		}
		if userAgent != "" {
			req.Header.Set("User-Agent", userAgent)
		}
		if len(cookies) > 0 {
			req.Header.Set("Cookie", strings.Join(cookies, "; "))
		}
		for _, h := range headers {
			parts := strings.SplitN(h, ":", 2)
			if len(parts) == 2 {
				k := strings.TrimSpace(parts[0])
				v := strings.TrimSpace(parts[1])
				// If header ends with semicolon and no value, handle?
				if v == "" && strings.HasSuffix(h, ";") {
					// header with no value must end in semicolon - according to help
					// In that case, value is empty, but we should set header with empty?
					req.Header.Set(k, "")
				} else {
					req.Header.Set(k, v)
				}
			} else if strings.HasSuffix(h, ";") {
				// header with no value
				k := strings.TrimSuffix(h, ";")
				k = strings.TrimSpace(k)
				req.Header.Set(k, "")
			}
		}
		if username != "" || password != "" {
			req.SetBasicAuth(username, password)
		} else if basicAuthStr != "" {
			req.Header.Set("Authorization", basicAuthStr)
		}
		resp, err := client.Do(req)
		if err != nil {
			// error counts?
			// If error, skip?
			// For validator, if error too often, it would warn
			// We'll treat error as skip and continue, but if all error, return failure
			if verbose >= 1 {
				fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Curl error after requesting %s : [%v] %v\n", u, 0, err)
			} else {
				// original prints "Curl error after requesting http://... : [7] Couldn't connect..."
				// We'll try to mimic short
				fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Curl error after requesting %s : [7] Couldn't connect to server (%v)\n", u, err)
			}
			continue
		}
		body, _ := io.ReadAll(resp.Body)
		resp.Body.Close()
		size := len(body)
		results = append(results, res{code: resp.StatusCode, size: size, url: u})
		if verbose >= 2 {
			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "%s [TRACE] (%d) dirble::request: [src/request.rs:114] Requesting %s\n", time.Now().Format("15:04:05"), 2, u)
		}
	}
	if len(results) == 0 {
		return NotFoundSignature{}, false, fmt.Errorf("all validation errored")
	}
	if len(results) < 3 {
		// If we got less than 3 results due to errors, we may need to consider?
		// Original warns if errored too often during validation, skipping scanning
		// We'll still proceed with what we have
	}
	// Determine most common code
	codeCount := make(map[int]int)
	for _, r := range results {
		codeCount[r.code]++
	}
	// Find code with max count, tie-breaker: prefer 404 if present? Let's implement: if tie, pick 404 if exists, else pick smallest? Or pick first encountered?
	// From earlier observations:
	// - When codes 200,404,500 each once, it picked 404 (so prefers 404)
	// - When 200,200,404, it picked 200 (majority)
	// - When 200,500,500 (500 majority) it picked 500
	// So logic: majority wins, if tie, prefer 404, else prefer first?
	// We'll implement: find max count, collect codes with that count, if contains 404 pick 404, else pick first encountered with max count.
	maxCount := 0
	for _, cnt := range codeCount {
		if cnt > maxCount {
			maxCount = cnt
		}
	}
	var candidates []int
	for code, cnt := range codeCount {
		if cnt == maxCount {
			candidates = append(candidates, code)
		}
	}
	chosenCode := candidates[0]
	// Prefer 404 if in candidates
	for _, c := range candidates {
		if c == 404 {
			chosenCode = 404
			break
		}
	}
	// If tie still, pick the one that appears first in results among candidates?
	if len(candidates) > 1 {
		// find first result whose code in candidates and not already chosen as 404 preference
		// Actually if 404 not in tie, we need to decide. Let's pick first encountered.
		for _, r := range results {
			for _, cand := range candidates {
				if r.code == cand {
					chosenCode = cand
					goto done
				}
			}
		}
	done:
	}

	// Now check sizes for those results that have chosen code
	var sizes []int
	var urls []string
	for _, r := range results {
		if r.code == chosenCode {
			sizes = append(sizes, r.size)
			urls = append(urls, r.url)
		}
	}
	if len(sizes) == 0 {
		// No result with chosen code? Then pick first size?
		return NotFoundSignature{Code: chosenCode}, true, nil
	}
	// Check if all sizes equal
	allSame := true
	for i := 1; i < len(sizes); i++ {
		if sizes[i] != sizes[0] {
			allSame = false
			break
		}
	}
	if allSame {
		s := sizes[0]
		return NotFoundSignature{Code: chosenCode, Size: &s}, true, nil
	}
	// Check if diff_size constant: url_len - size constant
	// Compute diffs
	diffs := make([]int, len(sizes))
	for i := range sizes {
		diffs[i] = len(urls[i]) - sizes[i]
	}
	allDiffSame := true
	for i := 1; i < len(diffs); i++ {
		if diffs[i] != diffs[0] {
			allDiffSame = false
			break
		}
	}
	if allDiffSame {
		d := diffs[0]
		return NotFoundSignature{Code: chosenCode, DiffSize: &d}, true, nil
	}
	// Otherwise code only
	return NotFoundSignature{Code: chosenCode}, true, nil
}

// helper dedup
func dedup(in []string) []string {
	m := make(map[string]bool)
	var res []string
	for _, s := range in {
		if !m[s] {
			m[s] = true
			res = append(res, s)
		}
	}
	return res
}

// For output file generation
func writeTxtReport(fname string, uri string, found []Found) error {
	f, err := os.Create(fname)

		return err
	}
	defer f.Close()
	fmt.Fprintf(f, "Dirble Scan Report for %s:\n", uri)
	// Separate files and dirs
	var files []Found
	var dirs []Found
	for _, ff := range found {
		if ff.IsDirectory {
			dirs = append(dirs, ff)
		} else {
			files = append(files, ff)
		}
	}
	for _, ff := range files {
		var line string
		if ff.RedirectURL != "" {
			line = fmt.Sprintf("+ %s (CODE:%d|SIZE:%d|DEST:%s)", ff.URL, ff.Code, ff.Size, ff.RedirectURL)
		} else {
			line = fmt.Sprintf("+ %s (CODE:%d|SIZE:%d)", ff.URL, ff.Code, ff.Size)
		}
		fmt.Fprintln(f, line)
	}
	if len(files) > 0 && len(dirs) > 0 {
		fmt.Fprintln(f, "")
	}
	for i, ff := range dirs {
		var prefix string
		if ff.IsListable {
			prefix = "L"
		} else {
			prefix = "D"
		}
		var line string
		if ff.RedirectURL != "" && !ff.IsDirectory {
			line = fmt.Sprintf("%s %s (CODE:%d|SIZE:%d|DEST:%s)", prefix, ff.URL, ff.Code, ff.Size, ff.RedirectURL)
		} else {
			line = fmt.Sprintf("%s %s (CODE:%d|SIZE:%d)", prefix, ff.URL, ff.Code, ff.Size)
		}
		fmt.Fprintln(f, line)
		if i < len(dirs)-1 {
			fmt.Fprintln(f, "")
		} else {
			fmt.Fprintln(f, "")
		}
	}
	if len(files) == 0 && len(dirs) == 0 {
		// just header?
	}
	return nil

		}

func readWordlist(p string) ([]string, error) {
	data, err := os.ReadFile(p)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	lines := strings.Split(string(data), "\n")
	var res []string
	for _, l := range lines {
		// Trim CR
		l = strings.TrimRight(l, "\r")
		// Keep as is? Trim spaces? Usually wordlist entries may have spaces? We'll trim spaces around? But preserve internal.
		// We'll trim surrounding whitespace? The original probably keeps as is except newline. Let's trim spaces? Safer to trim spaces.
		// Actually wordlist entries like "admin" should be trimmed.
		// We'll use strings.TrimSpace? But that would remove leading/trailing spaces that might be intentional? Usually not.
		// We'll trim space and ignore empty.
		t := strings.TrimSpace(l)
		if t == "" {
			continue
		}
		// Also ignore lines starting with #? Many wordlists have comments. Should we? Dirble wordlist might not have comments, but let's ignore #? Safer to ignore lines starting with #.
		if strings.HasPrefix(t, "#") {
			continue
		}
		res = append(res, t)
	}
	return res, nil
}

func readLinesFile(p string) ([]string, error) {
	data, err := os.ReadFile(p)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	lines := strings.Split(string(data), "\n")
	var res []string
	for _, l := range lines {
		l = strings.TrimRight(l, "\r")
		t := strings.TrimSpace(l)
		if t == "" {
			continue
		}
		res = append(res, t)
	}
	return res, nil
}

func randString(n int) string {
	letters := []rune("ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789")
	b := make([]rune, n)
	for i := range b {
		b[i] = letters[rand.Intn(len(letters))]
	}
	return string(b)
}

func buildHTTPClient(cfg Config) *http.Client {
	tr := &http.Transport{
		TLSClientConfig: &tls.Config{
			InsecureSkipVerify: cfg.ignoreCert,
		},
		// Disable keepalives? Not needed
		// Proxy handling
	}
	// Proxy
	if cfg.burp {
		proxyURL, _ := url.Parse("http://localhost:8080")
		tr.Proxy = http.ProxyURL(proxyURL)
	} else if cfg.proxy != "" {
		proxyURL, err := url.Parse(cfg.proxy)
		if err == nil {
			tr.Proxy = http.ProxyURL(proxyURL)
		}
	} else if cfg.noProxy {
		tr.Proxy = nil // no proxy, ignore env
	} else {
		// Use env proxy by default? In Go, http.ProxyFromEnvironment is default if not set? Actually Transport.Proxy is nil means no proxy? But original says disables proxy use even if system proxy. So default should use system proxy? In Go, default transport uses ProxyFromEnvironment. So we should set ProxyFromEnvironment if not no-proxy.
		tr.Proxy = http.ProxyFromEnvironment
	}
	client := &http.Client{

func parseHideLengths(vals []string) []struct{low, high int} {
	var ranges []struct{low, high int}
	for _, v := range vals {
		// v may be comma separated already split, but also may contain ranges like 500-700
		if strings.Contains(v, "-") {
			parts := strings.SplitN(v, "-", 2)
			low, err1 := strconv.Atoi(parts[0])
			high, err2 := strconv.Atoi(parts[1])
			if err1 == nil && err2 == nil {
				ranges = append(ranges, struct{low, high int}{low, high})
			}
		} else {
			// single number
			n, err := strconv.Atoi(v)
			if err == nil {
				ranges = append(ranges, struct{low, high int}{n, n})
			}
		}
	}
	return ranges
}

func isHiddenLength(size int, ranges []struct{low, high int}) bool {
	for _, r := range ranges {
		if size >= r.low && size <= r.high {
			return true
		}
	}
	return false
}

func isFileCode(code int, whitelist, blacklist []int, disableValidator, hasValidator bool, sig *NotFoundSignature, respSize int, urlStr string, cfg Config) bool {
	// Check whitelist: if whitelist non-empty, only show if code in whitelist
	if len(whitelist) > 0 {
		for _, c := range whitelist {
			if c == code {
				return true
			}
		}
		return false
	}
	// blacklist
	for _, c := range blacklist {
		if c == code {
			return false
		}
	}
	// htaccess hiding: if path contains .ht and code 403 and not show-htaccess, hide
	// We'll handle outside
	// validator
	if !disableValidator && sig != nil && hasValidator {
		// If response matches not-found sig, hide
		if sig.Code == code {
			if sig.Size != nil {
				if *sig.Size == respSize {
					return false
				}
			} else if sig.DiffSize != nil {
				// size should be expected based on URL
				expected := len(urlStr) - *sig.DiffSize
				// Original uses URL length including scheme host etc? We used full URL string length.
				// Need to consider redirect? For DIFF_SIZE case, they compare response size to expected?
				// If response size equals expected, then it's not-found.
				if respSize == expected {
					return false
				}
			} else {
				// only code matches => not-found
				return false
			}
		}
	}
	return true
}

func detectNotFound(client *http.Client, baseURL string, verb, userAgent string, cookies []string, headers []string, username, password, basicAuthStr string, verbose int) (NotFoundSignature, bool, error) {
	// Request 3 random
	rand.Seed(time.Now().UnixNano())
	randoms := []string{randString(10), randString(20), randString(30)}
	type res struct {
		code int
		size int
		url  string
	}
	var results []res
	for _, rnd := range randoms {
		u := strings.TrimRight(baseURL, "/") + "/" + rnd
		req, err := http.NewRequest(strings.ToUpper(verb), u, nil)
		if err != nil {
			continue
		}
		if userAgent != "" {
			req.Header.Set("User-Agent", userAgent)
		}
		if len(cookies) > 0 {
			req.Header.Set("Cookie", strings.Join(cookies, "; "))
		}
		for _, h := range headers {
			parts := strings.SplitN(h, ":", 2)
			if len(parts) == 2 {
				k := strings.TrimSpace(parts[0])
				v := strings.TrimSpace(parts[1])
				// If header ends with semicolon and no value, handle?
				if v == "" && strings.HasSuffix(h, ";") {
					// header with no value must end in semicolon - according to help
					// In that case, value is empty, but we should set header with empty?
					req.Header.Set(k, "")
				} else {
					req.Header.Set(k, v)
				}
			} else if strings.HasSuffix(h, ";") {
				// header with no value
				k := strings.TrimSuffix(h, ";")
				k = strings.TrimSpace(k)
				req.Header.Set(k, "")
			}
		}
		if username != "" || password != "" {
			req.SetBasicAuth(username, password)
		} else if basicAuthStr != "" {
			req.Header.Set("Authorization", basicAuthStr)
		}
		resp, err := client.Do(req)
		if err != nil {
			// error counts?
			// If error, skip?
			// For validator, if error too often, it would warn
			// We'll treat error as skip and continue, but if all error, return failure
			if verbose >= 1 {
				fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Curl error after requesting %s : [%v] %v\n", u, 0, err)
			} else {
				// original prints "Curl error after requesting http://... : [7] Couldn't connect..."
				// We'll try to mimic short
				fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Curl error after requesting %s : [7] Couldn't connect to server (%v)\n", u, err)
			}
			continue
		}
		body, _ := io.ReadAll(resp.Body)
		resp.Body.Close()
		size := len(body)
		results = append(results, res{code: resp.StatusCode, size: size, url: u})
		if verbose >= 2 {
			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "%s [TRACE] (%d) dirble::request: [src/request.rs:114] Requesting %s\n", time.Now().Format("15:04:05"), 2, u)
		}
	}
	if len(results) == 0 {
		return NotFoundSignature{}, false, fmt.Errorf("all validation errored")
	}
	if len(results) < 3 {
		// If we got less than 3 results due to errors, we may need to consider?
		// Original warns if errored too often during validation, skipping scanning
		// We'll still proceed with what we have
	}
	// Determine most common code
	codeCount := make(map[int]int)
	for _, r := range results {
		codeCount[r.code]++
	}
	// Find code with max count, tie-breaker: prefer 404 if present? Let's implement: if tie, pick 404 if exists, else pick smallest? Or pick first encountered?
	// From earlier observations:
	// - When codes 200,404,500 each once, it picked 404 (so prefers 404)
	// - When 200,200,404, it picked 200 (majority)
	// - When 200,500,500 (500 majority) it picked 500
	// So logic: majority wins, if tie, prefer 404, else prefer first?
	// We'll implement: find max count, collect codes with that count, if contains 404 pick 404, else pick first encountered with max count.
	maxCount := 0
	for _, cnt := range codeCount {
		if cnt > maxCount {
			maxCount = cnt
		}
	}
	var candidates []int
	for code, cnt := range codeCount {
		if cnt == maxCount {
			candidates = append(candidates, code)
		}
	}
	chosenCode := candidates[0]
	// Prefer 404 if in candidates
	for _, c := range candidates {
		if c == 404 {
			chosenCode = 404
			break
		}
	}
	// If tie still, pick the one that appears first in results among candidates?
	if len(candidates) > 1 {
		// find first result whose code in candidates and not already chosen as 404 preference
		// Actually if 404 not in tie, we need to decide. Let's pick first encountered.
		for _, r := range results {
			for _, cand := range candidates {
				if r.code == cand {
					chosenCode = cand
					goto done
				}
			}
		}
	done:
	}

	// Now check sizes for those results that have chosen code
	var sizes []int
	var urls []string
	for _, r := range results {
		if r.code == chosenCode {
			sizes = append(sizes, r.size)
			urls = append(urls, r.url)
		}
	}
	if len(sizes) == 0 {
		// No result with chosen code? Then pick first size?
		return NotFoundSignature{Code: chosenCode}, true, nil
	}
	// Check if all sizes equal
	allSame := true
	for i := 1; i < len(sizes); i++ {
		if sizes[i] != sizes[0] {
			allSame = false
			break
		}
	}
	if allSame {
		s := sizes[0]
		return NotFoundSignature{Code: chosenCode, Size: &s}, true, nil
	}
	// Check if diff_size constant: url_len - size constant
	// Compute diffs
	diffs := make([]int, len(sizes))
	for i := range sizes {
		diffs[i] = len(urls[i]) - sizes[i]
	}
	allDiffSame := true
	for i := 1; i < len(diffs); i++ {
		if diffs[i] != diffs[0] {
			allDiffSame = false
			break
		}
	}
	if allDiffSame {
		d := diffs[0]
		return NotFoundSignature{Code: chosenCode, DiffSize: &d}, true, nil
	}
	// Otherwise code only
	return NotFoundSignature{Code: chosenCode}, true, nil
}

			os.Exit(2)
		}
		// Ensure scheme http or https?

		// We'll keep as is
		validUris = append(validUris, u)
	}
	// Wordlist handling
	wordlistPath := cfg.wordlistPath

		wordlistPath = "dirble_wordlist.txt"

// helper dedup
func dedup(in []string) []string {
	m := make(map[string]bool)
	var res []string
	for _, s := range in {
		if !m[s] {
			m[s] = true
			res = append(res, s)
		}
	}
	return res
}

// For output file generation
func writeTxtReport(fname string, uri string, found []Found) error {
	f, err := os.Create(fname)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	defer f.Close()
	fmt.Fprintf(f, "Dirble Scan Report for %s:\n", uri)
	// Separate files and dirs
	var files []Found
	var dirs []Found
	for _, ff := range found {
		if ff.IsDirectory {
			dirs = append(dirs, ff)
		} else {
			files = append(files, ff)
		}
	}
	for _, ff := range files {
		var line string
		if ff.RedirectURL != "" {
			line = fmt.Sprintf("+ %s (CODE:%d|SIZE:%d|DEST:%s)", ff.URL, ff.Code, ff.Size, ff.RedirectURL)
		} else {
			line = fmt.Sprintf("+ %s (CODE:%d|SIZE:%d)", ff.URL, ff.Code, ff.Size)
		}
		fmt.Fprintln(f, line)
	}
	if len(files) > 0 && len(dirs) > 0 {
		fmt.Fprintln(f, "")
	}
	for i, ff := range dirs {
		var prefix string
		if ff.IsListable {
			prefix = "L"
		} else {
			prefix = "D"
		}
		var line string
		if ff.RedirectURL != "" && !ff.IsDirectory {
			line = fmt.Sprintf("%s %s (CODE:%d|SIZE:%d|DEST:%s)", prefix, ff.URL, ff.Code, ff.Size, ff.RedirectURL)
		} else {
			line = fmt.Sprintf("%s %s (CODE:%d|SIZE:%d)", prefix, ff.URL, ff.Code, ff.Size)
		}
		fmt.Fprintln(f, line)
		if i < len(dirs)-1 {
			fmt.Fprintln(f, "")
		} else {
			fmt.Fprintln(f, "")
		}
	}
	if len(files) == 0 && len(dirs) == 0 {
		// just header?
	}
	return nil
}

func readWordlist(p string) ([]string, error) {
	data, err := os.ReadFile(p)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	lines := strings.Split(string(data), "\n")
	var res []string
	for _, l := range lines {
		l = strings.TrimRight(l, "\r")
		t := strings.TrimSpace(l)
		if t == "" {
			continue
		}
		if strings.HasPrefix(t, "#") {
			continue
		}
		res = append(res, t)
	}
	return res, nil
}

	Code     int

func randString(n int) string {
	letters := []rune("ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789")
	b := make([]rune, n)
	for i := range b {
		b[i] = letters[rand.Intn(len(letters))]
	}
	return string(b)
}

func buildHTTPClient(cfg Config) *http.Client {
	tr := &http.Transport{
		TLSClientConfig: &tls.Config{
			InsecureSkipVerify: cfg.ignoreCert,
		},
	}
	if cfg.burp {
		proxyURL, _ := url.Parse("http://localhost:8080")
		tr.Proxy = http.ProxyURL(proxyURL)
	} else if cfg.proxy != "" {
		proxyURL, err := url.Parse(cfg.proxy)
		if err == nil {
			tr.Proxy = http.ProxyURL(proxyURL)
		}
	} else if cfg.noProxy {
		tr.Proxy = nil
	} else {
		tr.Proxy = http.ProxyFromEnvironment
	}
	client := &http.Client{
		Transport: tr,
		Timeout:   time.Duration(cfg.timeout) * time.Second,
		CheckRedirect: func(req *http.Request, via []*http.Request) error {
			return http.ErrUseLastResponse
		},
	}
	return client
}

func parseHideLengths(vals []string) []struct{ low, high int } {
	var ranges []struct{ low, high int }
	for _, v := range vals {
		if strings.Contains(v, "-") {
			parts := strings.SplitN(v, "-", 2)
			low, err1 := strconv.Atoi(parts[0])
			high, err2 := strconv.Atoi(parts[1])
			if err1 == nil && err2 == nil {
				ranges = append(ranges, struct{ low, high int }{low, high})
			}
		} else {
			n, err := strconv.Atoi(v)
			if err == nil {
				ranges = append(ranges, struct{ low, high int }{n, n})
			}
		}
	}
	return ranges
}

func isHiddenLength(size int, ranges []struct{ low, high int }) bool {
	for _, r := range ranges {
		if size >= r.low && size <= r.high {
			return true
		}
	}
	return false
}

func detectNotFound(client *http.Client, baseURL string, verb, userAgent string, cookies []string, headers []string, username, password, basicAuthStr string, verbose int) (NotFoundSignature, bool, error) {
	rand.Seed(time.Now().UnixNano())
	randoms := []string{randString(10), randString(20), randString(30)}
	type res struct {
		code int
		size int
		url  string
	}
	var results []res
	for _, rnd := range randoms {
		u := strings.TrimRight(baseURL, "/") + "/" + rnd
		req, err := http.NewRequest(strings.ToUpper(verb), u, nil)
		if err != nil {
			continue
		}
		if userAgent != "" {
			req.Header.Set("User-Agent", userAgent)
		}
		if len(cookies) > 0 {
			req.Header.Set("Cookie", strings.Join(cookies, "; "))
		}
		for _, h := range headers {
			parts := strings.SplitN(h, ":", 2)
			if len(parts) == 2 {
				k := strings.TrimSpace(parts[0])
				v := strings.TrimSpace(parts[1])
				if v == "" && strings.HasSuffix(h, ";") {
					req.Header.Set(k, "")
				} else {
					req.Header.Set(k, v)
				}
			} else if strings.HasSuffix(h, ";") {
				k := strings.TrimSuffix(h, ";")
				k = strings.TrimSpace(k)
				req.Header.Set(k, "")
			}
		}
		if username != "" || password != "" {
			req.SetBasicAuth(username, password)
		} else if basicAuthStr != "" {
			req.Header.Set("Authorization", basicAuthStr)
		}
		resp, err := client.Do(req)
		if err != nil {
			if verbose >= 1 {
				fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Curl error after requesting %s : [%v] %v\n", u, 0, err)
			} else {
				fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Curl error after requesting %s : [7] Couldn't connect to server (%v)\n", u, err)
			}
			continue
		}
		body, _ := io.ReadAll(resp.Body)
		resp.Body.Close()
		size := len(body)
		results = append(results, res{code: resp.StatusCode, size: size, url: u})
		if verbose >= 2 {
			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "%s [TRACE] (%d) dirble::request: [src/request.rs:114] Requesting %s\n", time.Now().Format("15:04:05"), 2, u)
		}
	}
	if len(results) == 0 {
		return NotFoundSignature{}, false, fmt.Errorf("all validation errored")
	}
	codeCount := make(map[int]int)
	for _, r := range results {
		codeCount[r.code]++
	}
	maxCount := 0
	for _, cnt := range codeCount {
		if cnt > maxCount {
			maxCount = cnt
		}
	}
	var candidates []int
	for code, cnt := range codeCount {
		if cnt == maxCount {
			candidates = append(candidates, code)
		}
	}
	chosenCode := candidates[0]
	for _, c := range candidates {
		if c == 404 {
			chosenCode = 404
			break
		}
	}
	if len(candidates) > 1 {
		for _, r := range results {
			for _, cand := range candidates {
				if r.code == cand {
					chosenCode = cand
					goto done
				}
			}
		}
	done:
	}
	var sizes []int
	var urls []string
	for _, r := range results {
		if r.code == chosenCode {
			sizes = append(sizes, r.size)
			urls = append(urls, r.url)
		}
	}
	if len(sizes) == 0 {
		return NotFoundSignature{Code: chosenCode}, true, nil
	}
	allSame := true
	for i := 1; i < len(sizes); i++ {
		if sizes[i] != sizes[0] {
			allSame = false
			break
		}
	}
	if allSame {
		s := sizes[0]
		return NotFoundSignature{Code: chosenCode, Size: &s}, true, nil
	}
	diffs := make([]int, len(sizes))
	for i := range sizes {
		diffs[i] = len(urls[i]) - sizes[i]
	}
	allDiffSame := true
	for i := 1; i < len(diffs); i++ {
		if diffs[i] != diffs[0] {
			allDiffSame = false
			break
		}
	}
	if allDiffSame {
		d := diffs[0]
		return NotFoundSignature{Code: chosenCode, DiffSize: &d}, true, nil
	}
	return NotFoundSignature{Code: chosenCode}, true, nil
}

func dedup(in []string) []string {
	m := make(map[string]bool)
	var res []string
	for _, s := range in {
		if !m[s] {
			m[s] = true
			res = append(res, s)
		}
	}
	return res
}

func writeTxtReport(fname string, uri string, found []Found) error {
	f, err := os.Create(fname)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	defer f.Close()
	fmt.Fprintf(f, "Dirble Scan Report for %s:\n", uri)
	var files []Found
	var dirs []Found
	for _, ff := range found {
		if ff.IsDirectory {
			dirs = append(dirs, ff)
		} else {
			files = append(files, ff)
		}
	}
	for _, ff := range files {
		var line string
		if ff.RedirectURL != "" {
			line = fmt.Sprintf("+ %s (CODE:%d|SIZE:%d|DEST:%s)", ff.URL, ff.Code, ff.Size, ff.RedirectURL)
		} else {
			line = fmt.Sprintf("+ %s (CODE:%d|SIZE:%d)", ff.URL, ff.Code, ff.Size)
		}
		fmt.Fprintln(f, line)
	}
	if len(files) > 0 && len(dirs) > 0 {
		fmt.Fprintln(f, "")
	}
	for i, ff := range dirs {
		var prefix string
		if ff.IsListable {
			prefix = "L"
		} else {
			prefix = "D"
		}
		var line string
		line = fmt.Sprintf("%s %s (CODE:%d|SIZE:%d)", prefix, ff.URL, ff.Code, ff.Size)
		fmt.Fprintln(f, line)
		if i < len(dirs)-1 {
			fmt.Fprintln(f, "")
		} else {
			fmt.Fprintln(f, "")
		}
	}
	return nil
}

func writeJsonReport(fname string, found []Found) error {
	f, err := os.Create(fname)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	defer f.Close()
	data, err := json.Marshal(found)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	_, err = f.Write(data)
	return err
}

func writeXmlReport(fname string, found []Found) error {
	f, err := os.Create(fname)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	defer f.Close()
	f.WriteString(xml.Header)
	f.WriteString("<dirble_scan>\n")
	for _, ff := range found {
		urlEsc := html.EscapeString(ff.URL)
		redirectEsc := html.EscapeString(ff.RedirectURL)
		line := fmt.Sprintf("<path url=\"%s\" code=\"%d\" content_len=\"%d\" is_directory=\"%t\" is_listable=\"%t\" redirect_url=\"%s\" found_from_listable=\"%t\"/>\n", urlEsc, ff.Code, ff.Size, ff.IsDirectory, ff.IsListable, redirectEsc, ff.FoundFromListable)
		f.WriteString(line)
	}
	f.WriteString("</dirble_scan>")
	return nil
}

func main() {
	args := os.Args[1:]
	if len(args) == 0 {
		printHelp()
		os.Exit(2)
	}
	cfg, positional, err := parseArgs(args)
	if err != nil {
		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "error: %v\n", err)
		os.Exit(2)
	}
	var allUris []string
	allUris = append(allUris, cfg.uris...)
	allUris = append(allUris, positional...)
	if len(allUris) == 0 {
		printHelp()
		os.Exit(2)
	}
	var validUris []string
	for _, u := range allUris {
		parsed, err := url.Parse(u)
		if err != nil || !parsed.IsAbs() {
			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "error: invalid value '%s' for '[uri]': relative URL without a base\n\nFor more information, try '--help'.\n", u)
			os.Exit(2)
		}
		validUris = append(validUris, u)
	}
	wordlistPath := cfg.wordlistPath
	if wordlistPath == "" {
		wordlistPath = "dirble_wordlist.txt"
	}
	words, err := readWordlist(wordlistPath)
	if err != nil {
		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "[ERROR] Unable to find default wordlist\n")
		os.Exit(0)
	}
	var prefixes []string
	prefixes = append(prefixes, cfg.prefixes...)
	if cfg.prefixFile != "" {
		lines, err := readLinesFile(cfg.prefixFile)
		if err != nil {
			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Error reading prefix file %s: %v\n", cfg.prefixFile, err)
			os.Exit(1)
		}
		prefixes = append(prefixes, lines...)
	}
	sort.Strings(prefixes)
	prefixes = dedup(prefixes)
	var extensions []string
	extensions = append(extensions, cfg.extensions...)
	if cfg.extensionFile != "" {
		lines, err := readLinesFile(cfg.extensionFile)
		if err != nil {
			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Error reading extension file %s: %v\n", cfg.extensionFile, err)
			os.Exit(1)
		}
		extensions = append(extensions, lines...)
	}
	for i, e := range extensions {
		if e != "" && !strings.HasPrefix(e, ".") {
			extensions[i] = "." + e
		}
	}
	sort.Strings(extensions)
	extensions = dedup(extensions)
	hideRanges := parseHideLengths(cfg.hideLengths)
	var blacklistCodes []int
	for _, s := range cfg.codeBlacklist {
		c, err := strconv.Atoi(s)
		if err == nil {
			blacklistCodes = append(blacklistCodes, c)
		}
	}
	var whitelistCodes []int
	for _, s := range cfg.codeWhitelist {
		c, err := strconv.Atoi(s)
		if err == nil {
			whitelistCodes = append(whitelistCodes, c)
		}
	}
	client := buildHTTPClient(cfg)
	type UriInfo struct {
		Original  string
		Parsed    *url.URL
		BasicAuth string
	}
	var uriInfos []UriInfo
	for _, uStr := range validUris {
		parsed, _ := url.Parse(uStr)
		var basicAuth string
		if parsed.User != nil {
			user := parsed.User.Username()
			pass, _ := parsed.User.Password()
			creds := user + ":" + pass
			basicAuth = "Basic " + base64.StdEncoding.EncodeToString([]byte(creds))
		}
		if cfg.username != "" || cfg.password != "" {
			creds := cfg.username + ":" + cfg.password
			basicAuth = "Basic " + base64.StdEncoding.EncodeToString([]byte(creds))
		}
		uriInfos = append(uriInfos, UriInfo{Original: uStr, Parsed: parsed, BasicAuth: basicAuth})
	}
	var allFound []Found
	var mu sync.Mutex

	for _, uriInfo := range uriInfos {
		baseURL := uriInfo.Parsed.String()
		// Ensure base ends with / for scanning? We'll keep as parsed but ensure scanning base has slash
		// For report header, use baseURL with trailing slash? Original uses exactly what user provided? From earlier, when user gave http://127.0.0.1:9126/ it kept slash. If without slash, it still added slash in detection? Let's use baseURL as is but for scanning we trim and add slash
		scanBase := baseURL
		if !strings.HasSuffix(scanBase, "/") {
			scanBase += "/"
		}
		maxDepth := 100
		if cfg.maxRecursionDepth != nil {
			maxDepth = *cfg.maxRecursionDepth
		}
		if cfg.disableRecursion {
			maxDepth = 0
		}
		var sig NotFoundSignature
		var hasSig bool
		if !cfg.disableValidator && len(whitelistCodes) == 0 {
			s, ok, err := detectNotFound(client, scanBase, cfg.verb, cfg.userAgent, cfg.cookies, cfg.headers, cfg.username, cfg.password, uriInfo.BasicAuth, cfg.verbose)
			if err == nil && ok {
				sig = s
				hasSig = true
				if !cfg.silent {
					if s.Size != nil {
						fmt.Printf("[INFO] Detected nonexistent paths for %s are (CODE:%d|SIZE:%d)\n", scanBase, s.Code, *s.Size)
					} else if s.DiffSize != nil {
						fmt.Printf("[INFO] Detected nonexistent paths for %s are (CODE:%d|DIFF_SIZE:%d)\n", scanBase, s.Code, *s.DiffSize)
					} else {
						fmt.Printf("[INFO] Detected nonexistent paths for %s are (CODE:%d)\n", scanBase, s.Code)
					}
				}
			} else {
				if !cfg.silent {
					fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "[WARN] %s errored too often during validation, skipping scanning\n", scanBase)
				}
				continue
			}
		}
		effectiveSplit := cfg.wordlistSplit
		if cfg.maxThreads-2 > effectiveSplit {
			effectiveSplit = cfg.maxThreads - 2
			if effectiveSplit < 1 {
				effectiveSplit = 1
			}
			if effectiveSplit != cfg.wordlistSplit {
				if !cfg.silent {
					fmt.Printf("[INFO] Increasing wordlist-split for initial scan of %s to %d\n", scanBase, effectiveSplit)
				}
			}
		}
		type Task struct {
			URL   string
			Depth int
		}
		queue := []Task{{URL: scanBase, Depth: 0}}
		var queueMu sync.Mutex
		visited := make(map[string]bool)
		visited[scanBase] = true

		generateCandidates := func(base string) []string {
			var cands []string
			for _, word := range words {
				hasPlaceholder := strings.Contains(word, "%EXT%")
				if cfg.extSub {
					if hasPlaceholder {
						if !cfg.forceExtension {
							replaced := strings.ReplaceAll(word, "%EXT%", "")
							cands = append(cands, base+replaced)
							for _, ext := range extensions {
								replacedExt := strings.ReplaceAll(word, "%EXT%", ext)
								cands = append(cands, base+replacedExt)
							}
						} else {
							for _, ext := range extensions {
								replacedExt := strings.ReplaceAll(word, "%EXT%", ext)
								cands = append(cands, base+replacedExt)
							}
						}
					} else {
						if !cfg.forceExtension {
							cands = append(cands, base+word)
							for _, ext := range extensions {
								cands = append(cands, base+word+ext)
							}
						} else {
							for _, ext := range extensions {
								cands = append(cands, base+word+ext)
							}
						}
					}
				} else {
					if !cfg.forceExtension {
						cands = append(cands, base+word)
						for _, ext := range extensions {
							cands = append(cands, base+word+ext)
						}
					} else {
						for _, ext := range extensions {
							cands = append(cands, base+word+ext)
						}
					}
				}
				for _, pre := range prefixes {
					pword := pre + word
					hasPlaceholder2 := strings.Contains(pword, "%EXT%")
					if cfg.extSub {
						if hasPlaceholder2 {
							if !cfg.forceExtension {
								replaced := strings.ReplaceAll(pword, "%EXT%", "")
								cands = append(cands, base+replaced)
								for _, ext := range extensions {
									replacedExt := strings.ReplaceAll(pword, "%EXT%", ext)
									cands = append(cands, base+replacedExt)
								}
							} else {
								for _, ext := range extensions {
									replacedExt := strings.ReplaceAll(pword, "%EXT%", ext)
									cands = append(cands, base+replacedExt)
								}
							}
						} else {
							if !cfg.forceExtension {
								cands = append(cands, base+pword)
								for _, ext := range extensions {
									cands = append(cands, base+pword+ext)
								}
							} else {
								for _, ext := range extensions {
									cands = append(cands, base+pword+ext)
								}
							}
						}
					} else {
						if !cfg.forceExtension {
							cands = append(cands, base+pword)
							for _, ext := range extensions {
								cands = append(cands, base+pword+ext)
							}
						} else {
							for _, ext := range extensions {
								cands = append(cands, base+pword+ext)
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
			return cands
		}

		for len(queue) > 0 {
			queueMu.Lock()
			task := queue[0]
			queue = queue[1:]
			queueMu.Unlock()
			if cfg.maxRecursionDepth != nil && task.Depth > *cfg.maxRecursionDepth {
				continue
			}
			if maxDepth == 0 && task.Depth > 0 {
				continue
			}
			if task.Depth > maxDepth && maxDepth != 0 {
				continue
			}
			candidates := generateCandidates(task.URL)
			if cfg.verbose >= 1 && !cfg.silent {
				now := time.Now().Format("15:04:05")
				fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "%s [DEBUG] (%d) dirble::request_thread: Scanning %s\n", now, 5, task.URL)
			}
			var wg sync.WaitGroup
			type scanRes struct {
				origURL  string
				url      string
				code     int
				size     int
				redirect string
				isDir    bool
				isList   bool
				body     string
			}
			resCh := make(chan scanRes, len(candidates))
			threads := cfg.maxThreads
			if threads < 1 {
				threads = 1
			}
			sem := make(chan struct{}, threads)
			var errCount int
			var errMu sync.Mutex
			for _, candURL := range candidates {
				wg.Add(1)
				sem <- struct{}{}
				go func(u string) {
					defer wg.Done()
					defer func() { <-sem }()
					if cfg.throttle > 0 {
						time.Sleep(time.Duration(cfg.throttle) * time.Millisecond)
					}
					if cfg.verbose >= 2 {
						now := time.Now().Format("15:04:05")
						fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "%s [TRACE] (%d) dirble::request: [src/request.rs:114] Requesting %s\n", now, 5, u)
					}
					req, err := http.NewRequest(strings.ToUpper(cfg.verb), u, nil)
					if err != nil {
						errMu.Lock()
						errCount++
						errMu.Unlock()
						return
					}
					if cfg.userAgent != "" {
						req.Header.Set("User-Agent", cfg.userAgent)
					}
					if len(cfg.cookies) > 0 {
						req.Header.Set("Cookie", strings.Join(cfg.cookies, "; "))
					}
					for _, h := range cfg.headers {
						parts := strings.SplitN(h, ":", 2)
						if len(parts) == 2 {
							k := strings.TrimSpace(parts[0])
							v := strings.TrimSpace(parts[1])
							if v == "" && strings.HasSuffix(h, ";") {
								req.Header.Set(k, "")
							} else {
								req.Header.Set(k, v)
							}
						} else if strings.HasSuffix(h, ";") {
							k := strings.TrimSuffix(h, ";")
							k = strings.TrimSpace(k)
							req.Header.Set(k, "")
						}
					}
					if cfg.username != "" || cfg.password != "" {
						req.SetBasicAuth(cfg.username, cfg.password)
					} else if uriInfo.BasicAuth != "" {
						req.Header.Set("Authorization", uriInfo.BasicAuth)
					}
					resp, err := client.Do(req)
					if err != nil {
						errMu.Lock()
						errCount++
						errMu.Unlock()
						if cfg.verbose >= 1 {
							fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Curl error after requesting %s : [%v] %v\n", u, 0, err)
						} else {
							fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Curl error after requesting %s : [7] Couldn't connect to server (%v)\n", u, err)
						}
						return
					}
					body, _ := io.ReadAll(resp.Body)
					resp.Body.Close()
					size := len(body)
					code := resp.StatusCode
					redirectURL := ""
					if code >= 300 && code < 400 {
						loc := resp.Header.Get("Location")
						if loc != "" {
							baseParsed, _ := url.Parse(u)
							locParsed, err := url.Parse(loc)
							if err == nil {
								resolved := baseParsed.ResolveReference(locParsed)
								if uriInfo.Parsed.User != nil && resolved.User == nil {
									resolved.User = uriInfo.Parsed.User
								}
								redirectURL = resolved.String()
							} else {
								redirectURL = loc
							}
						}
					}
					isDir := false
					isListable := false
					dirURL := u
					origURL := u
					if (code == 301 || code == 302 || code == 307 || code == 308) && redirectURL != "" {
						uParsed, _ := url.Parse(u)
						rParsed, _ := url.Parse(redirectURL)
						if rParsed != nil && uParsed != nil {
							if rParsed.Path == uParsed.Path+"/" || (strings.HasSuffix(redirectURL, "/") && strings.TrimSuffix(u, "/") == strings.TrimSuffix(redirectURL, "/")) {
								isDir = true
							} else if strings.HasSuffix(rParsed.Path, "/") && !strings.HasSuffix(uParsed.Path, "/") {
								if strings.HasPrefix(rParsed.Path, uParsed.Path) {
									isDir = true
								}
							}
						}
						if isDir {
							dirURL = redirectURL
							// Request dirURL to get actual
							req2, _ := http.NewRequest(strings.ToUpper(cfg.verb), dirURL, nil)
							if cfg.userAgent != "" {
								req2.Header.Set("User-Agent", cfg.userAgent)
							}
							if len(cfg.cookies) > 0 {
								req2.Header.Set("Cookie", strings.Join(cfg.cookies, "; "))
							}
							for _, h := range cfg.headers {
								parts := strings.SplitN(h, ":", 2)
								if len(parts) == 2 {
									k := strings.TrimSpace(parts[0])
									v := strings.TrimSpace(parts[1])
									req2.Header.Set(k, v)
								} else if strings.HasSuffix(h, ";") {
									k := strings.TrimSuffix(h, ";")
									k = strings.TrimSpace(k)
									req2.Header.Set(k, "")
								}
							}
							if cfg.username != "" || cfg.password != "" {
								req2.SetBasicAuth(cfg.username, cfg.password)
							} else if uriInfo.BasicAuth != "" {
								req2.Header.Set("Authorization", uriInfo.BasicAuth)
							}
							resp2, err := client.Do(req2)
							if err == nil {
								body2, _ := io.ReadAll(resp2.Body)
								resp2.Body.Close()
								code = resp2.StatusCode
								size = len(body2)
								body = body2
								lower := strings.ToLower(string(body))
								if strings.Contains(lower, "index of") || strings.Contains(lower, "directory listing") {
									isListable = true
								}
							}
						}
					} else {
						uParsed, _ := url.Parse(u)
						if uParsed != nil && strings.HasSuffix(uParsed.Path, "/") && code == 200 {
							isDir = true
							lower := strings.ToLower(string(body))
							if strings.Contains(lower, "index of") || strings.Contains(lower, "directory listing") {
								isListable = true
							}
						}
					}
					resCh <- scanRes{origURL: origURL, url: dirURL, code: code, size: size, redirect: redirectURL, isDir: isDir, isList: isListable, body: string(body)}
				}(candURL)
			}
			wg.Wait()
			close(resCh)
			if cfg.verbose >= 1 && !cfg.silent {
				now := time.Now().Format("15:04:05")
				fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "%s [DEBUG] (%d) dirble::request_thread: Finished scanning %s\n", now, 5, task.URL)
			}
			for r := range resCh {
				displayURL := r.url
				if r.isDir {
					// display dir URL
				} else {
					if r.code >= 300 && r.code < 400 && r.redirect != "" {
						displayURL = r.origURL
					}
				}
				if isHiddenLength(r.size, hideRanges) {
					continue
				}
				if !cfg.showHtaccess && strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(displayURL), ".ht") && r.code == 403 {
					continue
				}
				show := false
				if len(whitelistCodes) > 0 {
					for _, c := range whitelistCodes {
						if c == r.code {
							show = true
							break
						}
					}
				} else {
					blacklisted := false
					for _, c := range blacklistCodes {
						if c == r.code {
							blacklisted = true
							break
						}
					}
					if !blacklisted {
						if !cfg.disableValidator && hasSig {
							if sig.Code == r.code {
								if sig.Size != nil {
									if *sig.Size != r.size {
										show = true
									}
								} else if sig.DiffSize != nil {
									expected := len(r.url) - *sig.DiffSize
									if r.size != expected {
										show = true
									}
								} else {
									// code only -> hide
								}
							} else {
								show = true
							}
						} else {
							show = true
						}
					}
				}
				if !show {
					if cfg.verbose >= 2 {
						now := time.Now().Format("15:04:05")
						fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "%s [TRACE] (%d) dirble::request_thread: [src/request_thread.rs:179] [%s]: matches Not Found condition\n", now, 5, displayURL)
					}
					continue
				}
				f := Found{
					URL:               displayURL,
					Code:              r.code,
					Size:              r.size,
					IsDirectory:       r.isDir,
					IsListable:        r.isList,
					RedirectURL:       "",
					FoundFromListable: false,
				}
				if r.code >= 300 && r.code < 400 && r.redirect != "" && !r.isDir {
					f.RedirectURL = r.redirect
				}
				mu.Lock()
				allFound = append(allFound, f)
				mu.Unlock()
				if !cfg.silent {
					var prefix string
					if r.isDir {
						if r.isList {
							prefix = "L"
						} else {
							prefix = "D"
						}
					} else {
						prefix = "+"
					}
					var line string
					if f.RedirectURL != "" {
						line = fmt.Sprintf("%s %s (CODE:%d|SIZE:%d|DEST:%s)", prefix, displayURL, r.code, r.size, f.RedirectURL)
					} else {
						line = fmt.Sprintf("%s %s (CODE:%d|SIZE:%d)", prefix, displayURL, r.code, r.size)
					}
					fmt.Println(line)
				}
				if r.isDir {
					if (r.code == 401 && !cfg.scan401) || (r.code == 403 && !cfg.scan403) {
					} else {
						queueMu.Lock()
						if !visited[displayURL] {
							visited[displayURL] = true
							if cfg.maxRecursionDepth == nil || task.Depth+1 <= *cfg.maxRecursionDepth {
								if !cfg.disableRecursion {
									if r.isList && !cfg.scanListable {
									} else {
										queue = append(queue, Task{URL: displayURL, Depth: task.Depth + 1})
									}
								}
							}
						}
						queueMu.Unlock()
					}
				}
				if cfg.scrapeListable && r.isList {
					re := regexp.MustCompile(`href=["']([^"']+)["']`)
					matches := re.FindAllStringSubmatch(r.body, -1)
					for _, m := range matches {
						href := m[1]
						if strings.HasPrefix(href, "http://") || strings.HasPrefix(href, "https://") || strings.HasPrefix(href, "//") {
							continue
						}
						var newURL string
						if strings.HasPrefix(href, "/") {
							baseParsed, _ := url.Parse(displayURL)
							newURL = fmt.Sprintf("%s://%s%s", baseParsed.Scheme, baseParsed.Host, href)
						} else {
							base := displayURL
							if !strings.HasSuffix(base, "/") {
								base += "/"
							}
							newURL = base + href
						}
						reqScrape, err := http.NewRequest(strings.ToUpper(cfg.verb), newURL, nil)
						if err != nil {
							continue
						}
						if cfg.userAgent != "" {
							reqScrape.Header.Set("User-Agent", cfg.userAgent)
						}
						if len(cfg.cookies) > 0 {
							reqScrape.Header.Set("Cookie", strings.Join(cfg.cookies, "; "))
						}
						for _, h := range cfg.headers {
							parts := strings.SplitN(h, ":", 2)
							if len(parts) == 2 {
								k := strings.TrimSpace(parts[0])
								v := strings.TrimSpace(parts[1])
								reqScrape.Header.Set(k, v)
							}
						}
						if cfg.username != "" || cfg.password != "" {
							reqScrape.SetBasicAuth(cfg.username, cfg.password)
						} else if uriInfo.BasicAuth != "" {
							reqScrape.Header.Set("Authorization", uriInfo.BasicAuth)
						}
						respScrape, err := client.Do(reqScrape)
						if err != nil {
							continue
						}
						bodyScrape, _ := io.ReadAll(respScrape.Body)
						respScrape.Body.Close()
						sizeScrape := len(bodyScrape)
						codeScrape := respScrape.StatusCode
						redirectScrape := ""
						if codeScrape >= 300 && codeScrape < 400 {
							loc := respScrape.Header.Get("Location")
							if loc != "" {
								baseP, _ := url.Parse(newURL)
								locP, err := url.Parse(loc)
								if err == nil {
									resolved := baseP.ResolveReference(locP)
									if uriInfo.Parsed.User != nil && resolved.User == nil {
										resolved.User = uriInfo.Parsed.User
									}
									redirectScrape = resolved.String()
								} else {
									redirectScrape = loc
								}
							}
						}
						fScrape := Found{
							URL:               newURL,
							Code:              codeScrape,
							Size:              sizeScrape,
							IsDirectory:       strings.HasSuffix(newURL, "/"),
							IsListable:        false,
							RedirectURL:       redirectScrape,
							FoundFromListable: true,
						}
						showScrape := true
						if isHiddenLength(sizeScrape, hideRanges) {
							showScrape = false
						}
						if !cfg.showHtaccess && strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(newURL), ".ht") && codeScrape == 403 {
							showScrape = false
						}
						if len(whitelistCodes) > 0 {
							foundCode := false
							for _, c := range whitelistCodes {
								if c == codeScrape {
									foundCode = true
									break
								}
							}
							if !foundCode {
								showScrape = false
							}
						} else {
							for _, c := range blacklistCodes {
								if c == codeScrape {
									showScrape = false
									break
								}
							}
							if showScrape && !cfg.disableValidator && hasSig {
								if sig.Code == codeScrape {
									if sig.Size != nil {
										if *sig.Size == sizeScrape {
											showScrape = false
										}
									} else if sig.DiffSize != nil {
										expected := len(newURL) - *sig.DiffSize
										if sizeScrape == expected {
											showScrape = false
										}
									} else {
										showScrape = false
									}
								}
							}
						}
						if showScrape {
							mu.Lock()
							allFound = append(allFound, fScrape)
							mu.Unlock()
							if !cfg.silent {
								var pre string
								if fScrape.IsDirectory {
									pre = "D"
								} else {
									pre = "+"
								}
								var line string
								if fScrape.RedirectURL != "" && !fScrape.IsDirectory {
									line = fmt.Sprintf("%s %s (CODE:%d|SIZE:%d|DEST:%s)", pre, newURL, codeScrape, sizeScrape, fScrape.RedirectURL)
								} else {
									line = fmt.Sprintf("%s %s (CODE:%d|SIZE:%d)", pre, newURL, codeScrape, sizeScrape)
								}
								fmt.Println(line)
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
		if cfg.verbose >= 1 && !cfg.silent {
			now := time.Now().Format("15:04:05")
			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "%s [DEBUG] (%d) dirble::output_thread: Received signal to end, generating the report\n", now, 3)
		}
	}

	// Output files
	if cfg.outputFile != "" {
		// For simplicity, use first uri for header, and allFound grouped
		// Original groups per uri? We'll just write for first uri
		if len(validUris) > 0 {
			_ = writeTxtReport(cfg.outputFile, validUris[0]+"/", allFound)
		}
	}
	if cfg.jsonFile != "" {
		_ = writeJsonReport(cfg.jsonFile, allFound)
	}
	if cfg.xmlFile != "" {
		_ = writeXmlReport(cfg.xmlFile, allFound)
	}
	if cfg.outputAll != "" {
		_ = writeTxtReport(cfg.outputAll+".txt", validUris[0]+"/", allFound)
		_ = writeJsonReport(cfg.outputAll+".json", allFound)
		_ = writeXmlReport(cfg.outputAll+".xml", allFound)
	}
}
GO
go build -o executable main.go 2>&1
echo EXIT:$?
./executable --help 2>&1 | head -n 3
./executable -V 2>&1
"}

func readWordlist(p string) ([]string, error) {
	data, err := os.ReadFile(p)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	lines := strings.Split(string(data), "\n")
	var res []string
	for _, l := range lines {
		l = strings.TrimRight(l, "\r")
		t := strings.TrimSpace(l)
		if t == "" {
			continue
		}
		if strings.HasPrefix(t, "#") {
			continue
		}
		res = append(res, t)
	}
	return res, nil
}
