type NotFoundSignature struct {
	Code     int
	Size     *int
	DiffSize *int
}

func randString(n int) string {
	letters := []rune("ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789")
	b := make([]rune, n)
	for i := range b {
		b[i] = letters[rand.Intn(len(letters))]
	}
	return string(b)
}

func buildHTTPClient(cfg Config) *http.Client {
	tr := &http.Transport{
		TLSClientConfig: &tls.Config{
			InsecureSkipVerify: cfg.ignoreCert,
		},
	}
	if cfg.burp {
		proxyURL, _ := url.Parse("http://localhost:8080")
		tr.Proxy = http.ProxyURL(proxyURL)
	} else if cfg.proxy != "" {
		proxyURL, err := url.Parse(cfg.proxy)
		if err == nil {
			tr.Proxy = http.ProxyURL(proxyURL)
		}
	} else if cfg.noProxy {
		tr.Proxy = nil
	} else {
		tr.Proxy = http.ProxyFromEnvironment
	}
	client := &http.Client{
		Transport: tr,
		Timeout:   time.Duration(cfg.timeout) * time.Second,
		CheckRedirect: func(req *http.Request, via []*http.Request) error {
			return http.ErrUseLastResponse
		},
	}
	return client
}

func parseHideLengths(vals []string) []struct{ low, high int } {
	var ranges []struct{ low, high int }
	for _, v := range vals {
		if strings.Contains(v, "-") {
			parts := strings.SplitN(v, "-", 2)
			low, err1 := strconv.Atoi(parts[0])
			high, err2 := strconv.Atoi(parts[1])
			if err1 == nil && err2 == nil {
				ranges = append(ranges, struct{ low, high int }{low, high})
			}
		} else {
			n, err := strconv.Atoi(v)
			if err == nil {
				ranges = append(ranges, struct{ low, high int }{n, n})
			}
		}
	}
	return ranges
}

func isHiddenLength(size int, ranges []struct{ low, high int }) bool {
	for _, r := range ranges {
		if size >= r.low && size <= r.high {
			return true
		}
	}
	return false
}

func detectNotFound(client *http.Client, baseURL string, verb, userAgent string, cookies []string, headers []string, username, password, basicAuthStr string, verbose int) (NotFoundSignature, bool, error) {
	rand.Seed(time.Now().UnixNano())
	randoms := []string{randString(10), randString(20), randString(30)}
	type res struct {
		code int
		size int
		url  string
	}
	var results []res
	for _, rnd := range randoms {
		u := strings.TrimRight(baseURL, "/") + "/" + rnd
		req, err := http.NewRequest(strings.ToUpper(verb), u, nil)
		if err != nil {
			continue
		}
		if userAgent != "" {
			req.Header.Set("User-Agent", userAgent)
		}
		if len(cookies) > 0 {
			req.Header.Set("Cookie", strings.Join(cookies, "; "))
		}
		for _, h := range headers {
			parts := strings.SplitN(h, ":", 2)
			if len(parts) == 2 {
				k := strings.TrimSpace(parts[0])
				v := strings.TrimSpace(parts[1])
				if v == "" && strings.HasSuffix(h, ";") {
					req.Header.Set(k, "")
				} else {
					req.Header.Set(k, v)
				}
			} else if strings.HasSuffix(h, ";") {
				k := strings.TrimSuffix(h, ";")
				k = strings.TrimSpace(k)
				req.Header.Set(k, "")
			}
		}
		if username != "" || password != "" {
			req.SetBasicAuth(username, password)
		} else if basicAuthStr != "" {
			req.Header.Set("Authorization", basicAuthStr)
		}
		resp, err := client.Do(req)
		if err != nil {
			if verbose >= 1 {
				fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Curl error after requesting %s : [%v] %v\n", u, 0, err)
			} else {
				fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Curl error after requesting %s : [7] Couldn't connect to server (%v)\n", u, err)
			}
			continue
		}
		body, _ := io.ReadAll(resp.Body)
		resp.Body.Close()
		size := len(body)
		results = append(results, res{code: resp.StatusCode, size: size, url: u})
		if verbose >= 2 {
			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "%s [TRACE] (%d) dirble::request: [src/request.rs:114] Requesting %s\n", time.Now().Format("15:04:05"), 2, u)
		}
	}
	if len(results) == 0 {
		return NotFoundSignature{}, false, fmt.Errorf("all validation errored")
	}
	codeCount := make(map[int]int)
	for _, r := range results {
		codeCount[r.code]++
	}
	maxCount := 0
	for _, cnt := range codeCount {
		if cnt > maxCount {
			maxCount = cnt
		}
	}
	var candidates []int
	for code, cnt := range codeCount {
		if cnt == maxCount {
			candidates = append(candidates, code)
		}
	}
	chosenCode := candidates[0]
	for _, c := range candidates {
		if c == 404 {
			chosenCode = 404
			break
		}
	}
	if len(candidates) > 1 {
		for _, r := range results {
			for _, cand := range candidates {
				if r.code == cand {
					chosenCode = cand
					goto done
				}
			}
		}
	done:
	}
	var sizes []int
	var urls []string
	for _, r := range results {
		if r.code == chosenCode {
			sizes = append(sizes, r.size)
			urls = append(urls, r.url)
		}
	}
	if len(sizes) == 0 {
		return NotFoundSignature{Code: chosenCode}, true, nil
	}
	allSame := true
	for i := 1; i < len(sizes); i++ {
		if sizes[i] != sizes[0] {
			allSame = false
			break
		}
	}
	if allSame {
		s := sizes[0]
		return NotFoundSignature{Code: chosenCode, Size: &s}, true, nil
	}
	diffs := make([]int, len(sizes))
	for i := range sizes {
		diffs[i] = len(urls[i]) - sizes[i]
	}
	allDiffSame := true
	for i := 1; i < len(diffs); i++ {
		if diffs[i] != diffs[0] {
			allDiffSame = false
			break
		}
	}
	if allDiffSame {
		d := diffs[0]
		return NotFoundSignature{Code: chosenCode, DiffSize: &d}, true, nil
	}
	return NotFoundSignature{Code: chosenCode}, true, nil
}

func dedup(in []string) []string {
	m := make(map[string]bool)
	var res []string
	for _, s := range in {
		if !m[s] {
			m[s] = true
			res = append(res, s)
		}
	}
	return res
}

func writeTxtReport(fname string, uri string, found []Found) error {
	f, err := os.Create(fname)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	defer f.Close()
	fmt.Fprintf(f, "Dirble Scan Report for %s:\n", uri)
	var files []Found
	var dirs []Found
	for _, ff := range found {
		if ff.IsDirectory {
			dirs = append(dirs, ff)
		} else {
			files = append(files, ff)
		}
	}
	for _, ff := range files {
		var line string
		if ff.RedirectURL != "" {
			line = fmt.Sprintf("+ %s (CODE:%d|SIZE:%d|DEST:%s)", ff.URL, ff.Code, ff.Size, ff.RedirectURL)
		} else {
			line = fmt.Sprintf("+ %s (CODE:%d|SIZE:%d)", ff.URL, ff.Code, ff.Size)
		}
		fmt.Fprintln(f, line)
	}
	if len(files) > 0 && len(dirs) > 0 {
		fmt.Fprintln(f, "")
	}
	for i, ff := range dirs {
		var prefix string
		if ff.IsListable {
			prefix = "L"
		} else {
			prefix = "D"
		}
		var line string
		line = fmt.Sprintf("%s %s (CODE:%d|SIZE:%d)", prefix, ff.URL, ff.Code, ff.Size)
		fmt.Fprintln(f, line)
		if i < len(dirs)-1 {
			fmt.Fprintln(f, "")
		} else {
			fmt.Fprintln(f, "")
		}
	}
	return nil
}

func writeJsonReport(fname string, found []Found) error {
	f, err := os.Create(fname)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	defer f.Close()
	data, err := json.Marshal(found)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	_, err = f.Write(data)
	return err
}

func writeXmlReport(fname string, found []Found) error {
	f, err := os.Create(fname)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	defer f.Close()
	f.WriteString(xml.Header)
	f.WriteString("<dirble_scan>\n")
	for _, ff := range found {
		urlEsc := html.EscapeString(ff.URL)
		redirectEsc := html.EscapeString(ff.RedirectURL)
		line := fmt.Sprintf("<path url=\"%s\" code=\"%d\" content_len=\"%d\" is_directory=\"%t\" is_listable=\"%t\" redirect_url=\"%s\" found_from_listable=\"%t\"/>\n", urlEsc, ff.Code, ff.Size, ff.IsDirectory, ff.IsListable, redirectEsc, ff.FoundFromListable)
		f.WriteString(line)
	}
	f.WriteString("</dirble_scan>")
	return nil
}

func main() {
	args := os.Args[1:]
	if len(args) == 0 {
		printHelp()
		os.Exit(2)
	}
	cfg, positional, err := parseArgs(args)
	if err != nil {
		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "error: %v\n", err)
		os.Exit(2)
	}
	var allUris []string
	allUris = append(allUris, cfg.uris...)
	allUris = append(allUris, positional...)
	if len(allUris) == 0 {
		printHelp()
		os.Exit(2)
	}
	var validUris []string
	for _, u := range allUris {
		parsed, err := url.Parse(u)
		if err != nil || !parsed.IsAbs() {
			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "error: invalid value '%s' for '[uri]': relative URL without a base\n\nFor more information, try '--help'.\n", u)
			os.Exit(2)
		}
		validUris = append(validUris, u)
	}
	wordlistPath := cfg.wordlistPath
	if wordlistPath == "" {
		wordlistPath = "dirble_wordlist.txt"
	}
	words, err := readWordlist(wordlistPath)
	if err != nil {
		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "[ERROR] Unable to find default wordlist\n")
		os.Exit(0)
	}
	var prefixes []string
	prefixes = append(prefixes, cfg.prefixes...)
	if cfg.prefixFile != "" {
		lines, err := readLinesFile(cfg.prefixFile)
		if err != nil {
			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Error reading prefix file %s: %v\n", cfg.prefixFile, err)
			os.Exit(1)
		}
		prefixes = append(prefixes, lines...)
	}
	sort.Strings(prefixes)
	prefixes = dedup(prefixes)
	var extensions []string
	extensions = append(extensions, cfg.extensions...)
	if cfg.extensionFile != "" {
		lines, err := readLinesFile(cfg.extensionFile)
		if err != nil {
			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Error reading extension file %s: %v\n", cfg.extensionFile, err)
			os.Exit(1)
		}
		extensions = append(extensions, lines...)
	}
	for i, e := range extensions {
		if e != "" && !strings.HasPrefix(e, ".") {
			extensions[i] = "." + e
		}
	}
	sort.Strings(extensions)
	extensions = dedup(extensions)
	hideRanges := parseHideLengths(cfg.hideLengths)
	var blacklistCodes []int
	for _, s := range cfg.codeBlacklist {
		c, err := strconv.Atoi(s)
		if err == nil {
			blacklistCodes = append(blacklistCodes, c)
		}
	}
	var whitelistCodes []int
	for _, s := range cfg.codeWhitelist {
		c, err := strconv.Atoi(s)
		if err == nil {
			whitelistCodes = append(whitelistCodes, c)
		}
	}
	client := buildHTTPClient(cfg)
	type UriInfo struct {
		Original  string
		Parsed    *url.URL
		BasicAuth string
	}
	var uriInfos []UriInfo
	for _, uStr := range validUris {
		parsed, _ := url.Parse(uStr)
		var basicAuth string
		if parsed.User != nil {
			user := parsed.User.Username()
			pass, _ := parsed.User.Password()
			creds := user + ":" + pass
			basicAuth = "Basic " + base64.StdEncoding.EncodeToString([]byte(creds))
		}
		if cfg.username != "" || cfg.password != "" {
			creds := cfg.username + ":" + cfg.password
			basicAuth = "Basic " + base64.StdEncoding.EncodeToString([]byte(creds))
		}
		uriInfos = append(uriInfos, UriInfo{Original: uStr, Parsed: parsed, BasicAuth: basicAuth})
	}
	var allFound []Found
	var mu sync.Mutex

	for _, uriInfo := range uriInfos {
		baseURL := uriInfo.Parsed.String()
		// Ensure base ends with / for scanning? We'll keep as parsed but ensure scanning base has slash
		// For report header, use baseURL with trailing slash? Original uses exactly what user provided? From earlier, when user gave http://127.0.0.1:9126/ it kept slash. If without slash, it still added slash in detection? Let's use baseURL as is but for scanning we trim and add slash
		scanBase := baseURL
		if !strings.HasSuffix(scanBase, "/") {
			scanBase += "/"
		}
		maxDepth := 100
		if cfg.maxRecursionDepth != nil {
			maxDepth = *cfg.maxRecursionDepth
		}
		if cfg.disableRecursion {
			maxDepth = 0
		}
		var sig NotFoundSignature
		var hasSig bool
		if !cfg.disableValidator && len(whitelistCodes) == 0 {
			s, ok, err := detectNotFound(client, scanBase, cfg.verb, cfg.userAgent, cfg.cookies, cfg.headers, cfg.username, cfg.password, uriInfo.BasicAuth, cfg.verbose)
			if err == nil && ok {
				sig = s
				hasSig = true
				if !cfg.silent {
					if s.Size != nil {
						fmt.Printf("[INFO] Detected nonexistent paths for %s are (CODE:%d|SIZE:%d)\n", scanBase, s.Code, *s.Size)
					} else if s.DiffSize != nil {
						fmt.Printf("[INFO] Detected nonexistent paths for %s are (CODE:%d|DIFF_SIZE:%d)\n", scanBase, s.Code, *s.DiffSize)
					} else {
						fmt.Printf("[INFO] Detected nonexistent paths for %s are (CODE:%d)\n", scanBase, s.Code)
					}
				}
			} else {
				if !cfg.silent {
					fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "[WARN] %s errored too often during validation, skipping scanning\n", scanBase)
				}
				continue
			}
		}
		effectiveSplit := cfg.wordlistSplit
		if cfg.maxThreads-2 > effectiveSplit {
			effectiveSplit = cfg.maxThreads - 2
			if effectiveSplit < 1 {
				effectiveSplit = 1
			}
			if effectiveSplit != cfg.wordlistSplit {
				if !cfg.silent {
					fmt.Printf("[INFO] Increasing wordlist-split for initial scan of %s to %d\n", scanBase, effectiveSplit)
				}
			}
		}
		type Task struct {
			URL   string
			Depth int
		}
		queue := []Task{{URL: scanBase, Depth: 0}}
		var queueMu sync.Mutex
		visited := make(map[string]bool)
		visited[scanBase] = true

		generateCandidates := func(base string) []string {
			var cands []string
			for _, word := range words {
				hasPlaceholder := strings.Contains(word, "%EXT%")
				if cfg.extSub {
					if hasPlaceholder {
						if !cfg.forceExtension {
							replaced := strings.ReplaceAll(word, "%EXT%", "")
							cands = append(cands, base+replaced)
							for _, ext := range extensions {
								replacedExt := strings.ReplaceAll(word, "%EXT%", ext)
								cands = append(cands, base+replacedExt)
							}
						} else {
							for _, ext := range extensions {
								replacedExt := strings.ReplaceAll(word, "%EXT%", ext)
								cands = append(cands, base+replacedExt)
							}
						}
					} else {
						if !cfg.forceExtension {
							cands = append(cands, base+word)
							for _, ext := range extensions {
								cands = append(cands, base+word+ext)
							}
						} else {
							for _, ext := range extensions {
								cands = append(cands, base+word+ext)
							}
						}
					}
				} else {
					if !cfg.forceExtension {
						cands = append(cands, base+word)
						for _, ext := range extensions {
							cands = append(cands, base+word+ext)
						}
					} else {
						for _, ext := range extensions {
							cands = append(cands, base+word+ext)
						}
					}
				}
				for _, pre := range prefixes {
					pword := pre + word
					hasPlaceholder2 := strings.Contains(pword, "%EXT%")
					if cfg.extSub {
						if hasPlaceholder2 {
							if !cfg.forceExtension {
								replaced := strings.ReplaceAll(pword, "%EXT%", "")
								cands = append(cands, base+replaced)
								for _, ext := range extensions {
									replacedExt := strings.ReplaceAll(pword, "%EXT%", ext)
									cands = append(cands, base+replacedExt)
								}
							} else {
								for _, ext := range extensions {
									replacedExt := strings.ReplaceAll(pword, "%EXT%", ext)
									cands = append(cands, base+replacedExt)
								}
							}
						} else {
							if !cfg.forceExtension {
								cands = append(cands, base+pword)
								for _, ext := range extensions {
									cands = append(cands, base+pword+ext)
								}
							} else {
								for _, ext := range extensions {
									cands = append(cands, base+pword+ext)
								}
							}
						}
					} else {
						if !cfg.forceExtension {
							cands = append(cands, base+pword)
							for _, ext := range extensions {
								cands = append(cands, base+pword+ext)
							}
						} else {
							for _, ext := range extensions {
								cands = append(cands, base+pword+ext)
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
			return cands
		}

		for len(queue) > 0 {
			queueMu.Lock()
			task := queue[0]
			queue = queue[1:]
			queueMu.Unlock()
			if cfg.maxRecursionDepth != nil && task.Depth > *cfg.maxRecursionDepth {
				continue
			}
			if maxDepth == 0 && task.Depth > 0 {
				continue
			}
			if task.Depth > maxDepth && maxDepth != 0 {
				continue
			}
			candidates := generateCandidates(task.URL)
			if cfg.verbose >= 1 && !cfg.silent {
				now := time.Now().Format("15:04:05")
				fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "%s [DEBUG] (%d) dirble::request_thread: Scanning %s\n", now, 5, task.URL)
			}
			var wg sync.WaitGroup
			type scanRes struct {
				origURL  string
				url      string
				code     int
				size     int
				redirect string
				isDir    bool
				isList   bool
				body     string
			}
			resCh := make(chan scanRes, len(candidates))
			threads := cfg.maxThreads
			if threads < 1 {
				threads = 1
			}
			sem := make(chan struct{}, threads)
			var errCount int
			var errMu sync.Mutex
			for _, candURL := range candidates {
				wg.Add(1)
				sem <- struct{}{}
				go func(u string) {
					defer wg.Done()
					defer func() { <-sem }()
					if cfg.throttle > 0 {
						time.Sleep(time.Duration(cfg.throttle) * time.Millisecond)
					}
					if cfg.verbose >= 2 {
						now := time.Now().Format("15:04:05")
						fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "%s [TRACE] (%d) dirble::request: [src/request.rs:114] Requesting %s\n", now, 5, u)
					}
					req, err := http.NewRequest(strings.ToUpper(cfg.verb), u, nil)
					if err != nil {
						errMu.Lock()
						errCount++
						errMu.Unlock()
						return
					}
					if cfg.userAgent != "" {
						req.Header.Set("User-Agent", cfg.userAgent)
					}
					if len(cfg.cookies) > 0 {
						req.Header.Set("Cookie", strings.Join(cfg.cookies, "; "))
					}
					for _, h := range cfg.headers {
						parts := strings.SplitN(h, ":", 2)
						if len(parts) == 2 {
							k := strings.TrimSpace(parts[0])
							v := strings.TrimSpace(parts[1])
							if v == "" && strings.HasSuffix(h, ";") {
								req.Header.Set(k, "")
							} else {
								req.Header.Set(k, v)
							}
						} else if strings.HasSuffix(h, ";") {
							k := strings.TrimSuffix(h, ";")
							k = strings.TrimSpace(k)
							req.Header.Set(k, "")
						}
					}
					if cfg.username != "" || cfg.password != "" {
						req.SetBasicAuth(cfg.username, cfg.password)
					} else if uriInfo.BasicAuth != "" {
						req.Header.Set("Authorization", uriInfo.BasicAuth)
					}
					resp, err := client.Do(req)
					if err != nil {
						errMu.Lock()
						errCount++
						errMu.Unlock()
						if cfg.verbose >= 1 {
							fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Curl error after requesting %s : [%v] %v\n", u, 0, err)
						} else {
							fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Curl error after requesting %s : [7] Couldn't connect to server (%v)\n", u, err)
						}
						return
					}
					body, _ := io.ReadAll(resp.Body)
					resp.Body.Close()
					size := len(body)
					code := resp.StatusCode
					redirectURL := ""
					if code >= 300 && code < 400 {
						loc := resp.Header.Get("Location")
						if loc != "" {
							baseParsed, _ := url.Parse(u)
							locParsed, err := url.Parse(loc)
							if err == nil {
								resolved := baseParsed.ResolveReference(locParsed)
								if uriInfo.Parsed.User != nil && resolved.User == nil {
									resolved.User = uriInfo.Parsed.User
								}
								redirectURL = resolved.String()
							} else {
								redirectURL = loc
							}
						}
					}
					isDir := false
					isListable := false
					dirURL := u
					origURL := u
					if (code == 301 || code == 302 || code == 307 || code == 308) && redirectURL != "" {
						uParsed, _ := url.Parse(u)
						rParsed, _ := url.Parse(redirectURL)
						if rParsed != nil && uParsed != nil {
							if rParsed.Path == uParsed.Path+"/" || (strings.HasSuffix(redirectURL, "/") && strings.TrimSuffix(u, "/") == strings.TrimSuffix(redirectURL, "/")) {
								isDir = true
							} else if strings.HasSuffix(rParsed.Path, "/") && !strings.HasSuffix(uParsed.Path, "/") {
								if strings.HasPrefix(rParsed.Path, uParsed.Path) {
									isDir = true
								}
							}
						}
						if isDir {
							dirURL = redirectURL
							// Request dirURL to get actual
							req2, _ := http.NewRequest(strings.ToUpper(cfg.verb), dirURL, nil)
							if cfg.userAgent != "" {
								req2.Header.Set("User-Agent", cfg.userAgent)
							}
							if len(cfg.cookies) > 0 {
								req2.Header.Set("Cookie", strings.Join(cfg.cookies, "; "))
							}
							for _, h := range cfg.headers {
								parts := strings.SplitN(h, ":", 2)
								if len(parts) == 2 {
									k := strings.TrimSpace(parts[0])
									v := strings.TrimSpace(parts[1])
									req2.Header.Set(k, v)
								} else if strings.HasSuffix(h, ";") {
									k := strings.TrimSuffix(h, ";")
									k = strings.TrimSpace(k)
									req2.Header.Set(k, "")
								}
							}
							if cfg.username != "" || cfg.password != "" {
								req2.SetBasicAuth(cfg.username, cfg.password)
							} else if uriInfo.BasicAuth != "" {
								req2.Header.Set("Authorization", uriInfo.BasicAuth)
							}
							resp2, err := client.Do(req2)
							if err == nil {
								body2, _ := io.ReadAll(resp2.Body)
								resp2.Body.Close()
								code = resp2.StatusCode
								size = len(body2)
								body = body2
								lower := strings.ToLower(string(body))
								if strings.Contains(lower, "index of") || strings.Contains(lower, "directory listing") {
									isListable = true
								}
							}
						}
					} else {
						uParsed, _ := url.Parse(u)
						if uParsed != nil && strings.HasSuffix(uParsed.Path, "/") && code == 200 {
							isDir = true
							lower := strings.ToLower(string(body))
							if strings.Contains(lower, "index of") || strings.Contains(lower, "directory listing") {
								isListable = true
							}
						}
					}
					resCh <- scanRes{origURL: origURL, url: dirURL, code: code, size: size, redirect: redirectURL, isDir: isDir, isList: isListable, body: string(body)}
				}(candURL)
			}
			wg.Wait()
			close(resCh)
			if cfg.verbose >= 1 && !cfg.silent {
				now := time.Now().Format("15:04:05")
				fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "%s [DEBUG] (%d) dirble::request_thread: Finished scanning %s\n", now, 5, task.URL)
			}
			for r := range resCh {
				displayURL := r.url
				if r.isDir {
					// display dir URL
				} else {
					if r.code >= 300 && r.code < 400 && r.redirect != "" {
						displayURL = r.origURL
					}
				}
				if isHiddenLength(r.size, hideRanges) {
					continue
				}
				if !cfg.showHtaccess && strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(displayURL), ".ht") && r.code == 403 {
					continue
				}
				show := false
				if len(whitelistCodes) > 0 {
					for _, c := range whitelistCodes {
						if c == r.code {
							show = true
							break
						}
					}
				} else {
					blacklisted := false
					for _, c := range blacklistCodes {
						if c == r.code {
							blacklisted = true
							break
						}
					}
					if !blacklisted {
						if !cfg.disableValidator && hasSig {
							if sig.Code == r.code {
								if sig.Size != nil {
									if *sig.Size != r.size {
										show = true
									}
								} else if sig.DiffSize != nil {
									expected := len(r.url) - *sig.DiffSize
									if r.size != expected {
										show = true
									}
								} else {
									// code only -> hide
								}
							} else {
								show = true
							}
						} else {
							show = true
						}
					}
				}
				if !show {
					if cfg.verbose >= 2 {
						now := time.Now().Format("15:04:05")
						fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "%s [TRACE] (%d) dirble::request_thread: [src/request_thread.rs:179] [%s]: matches Not Found condition\n", now, 5, displayURL)
					}
					continue
				}
				f := Found{
					URL:               displayURL,
					Code:              r.code,
					Size:              r.size,
					IsDirectory:       r.isDir,
					IsListable:        r.isList,
					RedirectURL:       "",
					FoundFromListable: false,
				}
				if r.code >= 300 && r.code < 400 && r.redirect != "" && !r.isDir {
					f.RedirectURL = r.redirect
				}
				mu.Lock()
				allFound = append(allFound, f)
				mu.Unlock()
				if !cfg.silent {
					var prefix string
					if r.isDir {
						if r.isList {
							prefix = "L"
						} else {
							prefix = "D"
						}
					} else {
						prefix = "+"
					}
					var line string
					if f.RedirectURL != "" {
						line = fmt.Sprintf("%s %s (CODE:%d|SIZE:%d|DEST:%s)", prefix, displayURL, r.code, r.size, f.RedirectURL)
					} else {
						line = fmt.Sprintf("%s %s (CODE:%d|SIZE:%d)", prefix, displayURL, r.code, r.size)
					}
					fmt.Println(line)
				}
				if r.isDir {
					if (r.code == 401 && !cfg.scan401) || (r.code == 403 && !cfg.scan403) {
					} else {
						queueMu.Lock()
						if !visited[displayURL] {
							visited[displayURL] = true
							if cfg.maxRecursionDepth == nil || task.Depth+1 <= *cfg.maxRecursionDepth {
								if !cfg.disableRecursion {
									if r.isList && !cfg.scanListable {
									} else {
										queue = append(queue, Task{URL: displayURL, Depth: task.Depth + 1})
									}
								}
							}
						}
						queueMu.Unlock()
					}
				}
				if cfg.scrapeListable && r.isList {
					re := regexp.MustCompile(`href=["']([^"']+)["']`)
					matches := re.FindAllStringSubmatch(r.body, -1)
					for _, m := range matches {
						href := m[1]
						if strings.HasPrefix(href, "http://") || strings.HasPrefix(href, "https://") || strings.HasPrefix(href, "//") {
							continue
						}
						var newURL string
						if strings.HasPrefix(href, "/") {
							baseParsed, _ := url.Parse(displayURL)
							newURL = fmt.Sprintf("%s://%s%s", baseParsed.Scheme, baseParsed.Host, href)
						} else {
							base := displayURL
							if !strings.HasSuffix(base, "/") {
								base += "/"
							}
							newURL = base + href
						}
						reqScrape, err := http.NewRequest(strings.ToUpper(cfg.verb), newURL, nil)
						if err != nil {
							continue
						}
						if cfg.userAgent != "" {
							reqScrape.Header.Set("User-Agent", cfg.userAgent)
						}
						if len(cfg.cookies) > 0 {
							reqScrape.Header.Set("Cookie", strings.Join(cfg.cookies, "; "))
						}
						for _, h := range cfg.headers {
							parts := strings.SplitN(h, ":", 2)
							if len(parts) == 2 {
								k := strings.TrimSpace(parts[0])
								v := strings.TrimSpace(parts[1])
								reqScrape.Header.Set(k, v)
							}
						}
						if cfg.username != "" || cfg.password != "" {
							reqScrape.SetBasicAuth(cfg.username, cfg.password)
						} else if uriInfo.BasicAuth != "" {
							reqScrape.Header.Set("Authorization", uriInfo.BasicAuth)
						}
						respScrape, err := client.Do(reqScrape)
						if err != nil {
							continue
						}
						bodyScrape, _ := io.ReadAll(respScrape.Body)
						respScrape.Body.Close()
						sizeScrape := len(bodyScrape)
						codeScrape := respScrape.StatusCode
						redirectScrape := ""
						if codeScrape >= 300 && codeScrape < 400 {
							loc := respScrape.Header.Get("Location")
							if loc != "" {
								baseP, _ := url.Parse(newURL)
								locP, err := url.Parse(loc)
								if err == nil {
									resolved := baseP.ResolveReference(locP)
									if uriInfo.Parsed.User != nil && resolved.User == nil {
										resolved.User = uriInfo.Parsed.User
									}
									redirectScrape = resolved.String()
								} else {
									redirectScrape = loc
								}
							}
						}
						fScrape := Found{
							URL:               newURL,
							Code:              codeScrape,
							Size:              sizeScrape,
							IsDirectory:       strings.HasSuffix(newURL, "/"),
							IsListable:        false,
							RedirectURL:       redirectScrape,
							FoundFromListable: true,
						}
						showScrape := true
						if isHiddenLength(sizeScrape, hideRanges) {
							showScrape = false
						}
						if !cfg.showHtaccess && strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(newURL), ".ht") && codeScrape == 403 {
							showScrape = false
						}
						if len(whitelistCodes) > 0 {
							foundCode := false
							for _, c := range whitelistCodes {
								if c == codeScrape {
									foundCode = true
									break
								}
							}
							if !foundCode {
								showScrape = false
							}
						} else {
							for _, c := range blacklistCodes {
								if c == codeScrape {
									showScrape = false
									break
								}
							}
							if showScrape && !cfg.disableValidator && hasSig {
								if sig.Code == codeScrape {
									if sig.Size != nil {
										if *sig.Size == sizeScrape {
											showScrape = false
										}
									} else if sig.DiffSize != nil {
										expected := len(newURL) - *sig.DiffSize
										if sizeScrape == expected {
											showScrape = false
										}
									} else {
										showScrape = false
									}
								}
							}
						}
						if showScrape {
							mu.Lock()
							allFound = append(allFound, fScrape)
							mu.Unlock()
							if !cfg.silent {
								var pre string
								if fScrape.IsDirectory {
									pre = "D"
								} else {
									pre = "+"
								}
								var line string
								if fScrape.RedirectURL != "" && !fScrape.IsDirectory {
									line = fmt.Sprintf("%s %s (CODE:%d|SIZE:%d|DEST:%s)", pre, newURL, codeScrape, sizeScrape, fScrape.RedirectURL)
								} else {
									line = fmt.Sprintf("%s %s (CODE:%d|SIZE:%d)", pre, newURL, codeScrape, sizeScrape)
								}
								fmt.Println(line)
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
		if cfg.verbose >= 1 && !cfg.silent {
			now := time.Now().Format("15:04:05")
			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "%s [DEBUG] (%d) dirble::output_thread: Received signal to end, generating the report\n", now, 3)
		}
	}

	// Output files
	if cfg.outputFile != "" {
		// For simplicity, use first uri for header, and allFound grouped
		// Original groups per uri? We'll just write for first uri
		if len(validUris) > 0 {
			_ = writeTxtReport(cfg.outputFile, validUris[0]+"/", allFound)
		}
	}
	if cfg.jsonFile != "" {
		_ = writeJsonReport(cfg.jsonFile, allFound)
	}
	if cfg.xmlFile != "" {
		_ = writeXmlReport(cfg.xmlFile, allFound)
	}
	if cfg.outputAll != "" {
		_ = writeTxtReport(cfg.outputAll+".txt", validUris[0]+"/", allFound)
		_ = writeJsonReport(cfg.outputAll+".json", allFound)
		_ = writeXmlReport(cfg.outputAll+".xml", allFound)
	}
}

	Code              int    `json:"code" xml:"code,attr"`
	Size              int    `json:"size" xml:"content_len,attr"`
	IsDirectory       bool   `json:"is_directory" xml:"is_directory,attr"`
	IsListable        bool   `json:"is_listable" xml:"is_listable,attr"`
	RedirectURL       string `json:"redirect_url" xml:"redirect_url,attr"`
	FoundFromListable bool   `json:"found_from_listable" xml:"found_from_listable,attr"`
}

func printHelp() {
	fmt.Print(helpStr)
}

func printVersion() {
	fmt.Println(versionStr)
}

func parseArgs(args []string) (Config, []string, error) {

		a := args[i]
		if a == "-h" || a == "--help" {
			printHelp()
			os.Exit(0)
		}
		if a == "-V" || a == "--version" {
			printVersion()

				fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "error: a value is required for '--verb <http_verb>' but none was supplied\n\nFor more information, try '--help'.\n")
				os.Exit(2)
			}
			val := args[i+1]
			if val != "get" && val != "head" && val != "post" {

			i += 2
			continue

			}
			fpath := args[i+1]
			data, err := os.ReadFile(fpath)
			if err != nil {
				fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Error reading file %s: %v\n", fpath, err)
				os.Exit(1)
			}
			lines := strings.Split(string(data), "\n")
			for _, line := range lines {
				line = strings.TrimSpace(line)
				if line != "" {
					cfg.uris = append(cfg.uris, line)
				}
			}
			i += 2
			continue
		}
		if strings.HasPrefix(a, "--uri-file=") {
			fpath := strings.TrimPrefix(a, "--uri-file=")
			data, err := os.ReadFile(fpath)
			if err != nil {
				fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Error reading file %s: %v\n", fpath, err)
				os.Exit(1)
			}
			lines := strings.Split(string(data), "\n")
			for _, line := range lines {
				line = strings.TrimSpace(line)
				if line != "" {
					cfg.uris = append(cfg.uris, line)
				}
			}
			i++
			continue
		}
		if strings.HasPrefix(a, "--url-file=") {
			fpath := strings.TrimPrefix(a, "--url-file=")
			data, err := os.ReadFile(fpath)
			if err != nil {
				fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Error reading file %s: %v\n", fpath, err)
				os.Exit(1)
			}
			lines := strings.Split(string(data), "\n")
			for _, line := range lines {
				line = strings.TrimSpace(line)
				if line != "" {
					cfg.uris = append(cfg.uris, line)
				}
			}
			i++
			continue
		}
		if !strings.HasPrefix(a, "-") {
			positional = append(positional, a)
			i++
			continue
		}
		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "error: unexpected argument '%s' found\n\n  tip: to pass '%s' as a value, use '-- %s'\n\nUsage: executable [OPTIONS] <uri|--uri-file <uri-file>|--uri <uri>>\n\nFor more information, try '--help'.\n", a, a, a)
		os.Exit(2)
	}
	return cfg, positional, nil
}

func readWordlist(p string) ([]string, error) {
	data, err := os.ReadFile(p)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	lines := strings.Split(string(data), "\n")
	var res []string
	for _, l := range lines {
		l = strings.TrimRight(l, "\r")
		t := strings.TrimSpace(l)
		if t == "" {
			continue
		}
		if strings.HasPrefix(t, "#") {
			continue
		}
		res = append(res, t)
	}
	return res, nil
}

func readLinesFile(p string) ([]string, error) {
	data, err := os.ReadFile(p)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	lines := strings.Split(string(data), "\n")
	var res []string
	for _, l := range lines {
		l = strings.TrimRight(l, "\r")
		t := strings.TrimSpace(l)
		if t == "" {
			continue
		}
		res = append(res, t)
	}
	return res, nil
}

type NotFoundSignature struct {
	Code     int
	Size     *int
	DiffSize *int
}

func randString(n int) string {
	letters := []rune("ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789")
	b := make([]rune, n)
	for i := range b {
		b[i] = letters[rand.Intn(len(letters))]
	}
	return string(b)
}

func buildHTTPClient(cfg Config) *http.Client {
	tr := &http.Transport{
		TLSClientConfig: &tls.Config{
			InsecureSkipVerify: cfg.ignoreCert,
		},
	}
	if cfg.burp {
		proxyURL, _ := url.Parse("http://localhost:8080")
		tr.Proxy = http.ProxyURL(proxyURL)
	} else if cfg.proxy != "" {
		proxyURL, err := url.Parse(cfg.proxy)
		if err == nil {
			tr.Proxy = http.ProxyURL(proxyURL)
		}
	} else if cfg.noProxy {
		tr.Proxy = nil
	} else {
		tr.Proxy = http.ProxyFromEnvironment
	}
	client := &http.Client{
		Transport: tr,
		Timeout:   time.Duration(cfg.timeout) * time.Second,
		CheckRedirect: func(req *http.Request, via []*http.Request) error {
			return http.ErrUseLastResponse
		},
	}
	return client
}

func parseHideLengths(vals []string) []struct{ low, high int } {
	var ranges []struct{ low, high int }
	for _, v := range vals {
		if strings.Contains(v, "-") {
			parts := strings.SplitN(v, "-", 2)
			low, err1 := strconv.Atoi(parts[0])
			high, err2 := strconv.Atoi(parts[1])
			if err1 == nil && err2 == nil {
				ranges = append(ranges, struct{ low, high int }{low, high})
			}
		} else {
			n, err := strconv.Atoi(v)
			if err == nil {
				ranges = append(ranges, struct{ low, high int }{n, n})
			}
		}
	}
	return ranges
}

func isHiddenLength(size int, ranges []struct{ low, high int }) bool {
	for _, r := range ranges {
		if size >= r.low && size <= r.high {
			return true
		}
	}
	return false
}

func detectNotFound(client *http.Client, baseURL string, verb, userAgent string, cookies []string, headers []string, username, password, basicAuthStr string, verbose int) (NotFoundSignature, bool, error) {
	rand.Seed(time.Now().UnixNano())
	randoms := []string{randString(10), randString(20), randString(30)}
	type res struct {
		code int
		size int
		url  string
	}
	var results []res
	for _, rnd := range randoms {
		u := strings.TrimRight(baseURL, "/") + "/" + rnd
		req, err := http.NewRequest(strings.ToUpper(verb), u, nil)
		if err != nil {
			continue
		}
		if userAgent != "" {
			req.Header.Set("User-Agent", userAgent)
		}
		if len(cookies) > 0 {
			req.Header.Set("Cookie", strings.Join(cookies, "; "))
		}
		for _, h := range headers {
			parts := strings.SplitN(h, ":", 2)
			if len(parts) == 2 {
				k := strings.TrimSpace(parts[0])
				v := strings.TrimSpace(parts[1])
				if v == "" && strings.HasSuffix(h, ";") {
					req.Header.Set(k, "")
				} else {
					req.Header.Set(k, v)
				}
			} else if strings.HasSuffix(h, ";") {
				k := strings.TrimSuffix(h, ";")
				k = strings.TrimSpace(k)
				req.Header.Set(k, "")
			}
		}
		if username != "" || password != "" {
			req.SetBasicAuth(username, password)
		} else if basicAuthStr != "" {
			req.Header.Set("Authorization", basicAuthStr)
		}
		resp, err := client.Do(req)
		if err != nil {
			if verbose >= 1 {
				fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Curl error after requesting %s : [%v] %v\n", u, 0, err)
			} else {
				fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Curl error after requesting %s : [7] Couldn't connect to server (%v)\n", u, err)
			}
			continue
		}
		body, _ := io.ReadAll(resp.Body)
		resp.Body.Close()
		size := len(body)
		results = append(results, res{code: resp.StatusCode, size: size, url: u})
		if verbose >= 2 {
			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "%s [TRACE] (%d) dirble::request: [src/request.rs:114] Requesting %s\n", time.Now().Format("15:04:05"), 2, u)
		}
	}
	if len(results) == 0 {
		return NotFoundSignature{}, false, fmt.Errorf("all validation errored")
	}
	codeCount := make(map[int]int)
	for _, r := range results {
		codeCount[r.code]++
	}
	maxCount := 0
	for _, cnt := range codeCount {
		if cnt > maxCount {
			maxCount = cnt
		}
	}
	var candidates []int
	for code, cnt := range codeCount {
		if cnt == maxCount {
			candidates = append(candidates, code)
		}
	}
	chosenCode := candidates[0]
	for _, c := range candidates {
		if c == 404 {
			chosenCode = 404
			break
		}
	}
	if len(candidates) > 1 {
		for _, r := range results {
			for _, cand := range candidates {
				if r.code == cand {
					chosenCode = cand
					goto done
				}
			}
		}
	done:
	}
	var sizes []int
	var urls []string
	for _, r := range results {
		if r.code == chosenCode {
			sizes = append(sizes, r.size)
			urls = append(urls, r.url)
		}
	}
	if len(sizes) == 0 {
		return NotFoundSignature{Code: chosenCode}, true, nil
	}
	allSame := true
	for i := 1; i < len(sizes); i++ {
		if sizes[i] != sizes[0] {
			allSame = false
			break
		}
	}
	if allSame {
		s := sizes[0]
		return NotFoundSignature{Code: chosenCode, Size: &s}, true, nil
	}
	diffs := make([]int, len(sizes))
	for i := range sizes {
		diffs[i] = len(urls[i]) - sizes[i]
	}
	allDiffSame := true
	for i := 1; i < len(diffs); i++ {
		if diffs[i] != diffs[0] {
			allDiffSame = false
			break
		}
	}
	if allDiffSame {
		d := diffs[0]
		return NotFoundSignature{Code: chosenCode, DiffSize: &d}, true, nil
	}
	return NotFoundSignature{Code: chosenCode}, true, nil
}

func dedup(in []string) []string {
	m := make(map[string]bool)
	var res []string
	for _, s := range in {
		if !m[s] {
			m[s] = true
			res = append(res, s)
		}
	}
	return res
}

func writeTxtReport(fname string, uri string, found []Found) error {
	f, err := os.Create(fname)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	defer f.Close()
	// Ensure uri ends with single slash for report header
	reportURI := uri
	if !strings.HasSuffix(reportURI, "/") {
		reportURI += "/"
	}
	// Remove double slashes except after scheme
	// Simple: replace "//" after host? We'll just ensure not double
	// For our case, uri already contains scheme, we already ensured single slash at end
	// But earlier we had "//" because we added slash to uri that already ended with "/"
	// So use TrimRight then add "/"
	reportURI = strings.TrimRight(uri, "/") + "/"
	fmt.Fprintf(f, "Dirble Scan Report for %s:\n", reportURI)
	var files []Found
	var dirs []Found
	for _, ff := range found {
		if ff.IsDirectory {
			dirs = append(dirs, ff)
		} else {
			files = append(files, ff)
		}
	}
	for _, ff := range files {
		var line string
		if ff.RedirectURL != "" {
			line = fmt.Sprintf("+ %s (CODE:%d|SIZE:%d|DEST:%s)", ff.URL, ff.Code, ff.Size, ff.RedirectURL)
		} else {
			line = fmt.Sprintf("+ %s (CODE:%d|SIZE:%d)", ff.URL, ff.Code, ff.Size)
		}
		fmt.Fprintln(f, line)
	}
	if len(files) > 0 && len(dirs) > 0 {
		fmt.Fprintln(f, "")
	}
	for i, ff := range dirs {
		var prefix string
		if ff.IsListable {
			prefix = "L"
		} else {
			prefix = "D"
		}
		line := fmt.Sprintf("%s %s (CODE:%d|SIZE:%d)", prefix, ff.URL, ff.Code, ff.Size)
		fmt.Fprintln(f, line)
		if i < len(dirs)-1 {
			fmt.Fprintln(f, "")
		} else {
			fmt.Fprintln(f, "")
		}
	}
	return nil
}

func writeJsonReport(fname string, found []Found) error {
	f, err := os.Create(fname)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	defer f.Close()
	// Marshal each individually to join with ",\n" as original
	var parts []string
	for _, ff := range found {
		b, _ := json.Marshal(ff)
		parts = append(parts, string(b))
	}
	joined := strings.Join(parts, ",\n")
	content := "[" + joined + "]"
	_, err = f.WriteString(content)
	return err
}

func writeXmlReport(fname string, found []Found) error {
	f, err := os.Create(fname)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	defer f.Close()
	f.WriteString(xml.Header)
	f.WriteString("<dirble_scan>\n")
	for _, ff := range found {
		urlEsc := html.EscapeString(ff.URL)
		redirectEsc := html.EscapeString(ff.RedirectURL)
		line := fmt.Sprintf("<path url=\"%s\" code=\"%d\" content_len=\"%d\" is_directory=\"%t\" is_listable=\"%t\" redirect_url=\"%s\" found_from_listable=\"%t\"/>\n", urlEsc, ff.Code, ff.Size, ff.IsDirectory, ff.IsListable, redirectEsc, ff.FoundFromListable)
		f.WriteString(line)
	}
	f.WriteString("</dirble_scan>")
	return nil
}

func main() {
	args := os.Args[1:]
	if len(args) == 0 {
		printHelp()
		os.Exit(2)
	}
	cfg, positional, err := parseArgs(args)
	if err != nil {
		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "error: %v\n", err)
		os.Exit(2)
	}
	var allUris []string
	allUris = append(allUris, cfg.uris...)
	allUris = append(allUris, positional...)
	if len(allUris) == 0 {
		printHelp()
		os.Exit(2)
	}
	var validUris []string
	for _, u := range allUris {
		parsed, err := url.Parse(u)
		if err != nil || !parsed.IsAbs() {
			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "error: invalid value '%s' for '[uri]': relative URL without a base\n\nFor more information, try '--help'.\n", u)
			os.Exit(2)
		}
		validUris = append(validUris, u)
	}
	wordlistPath := cfg.wordlistPath
	if wordlistPath == "" {
		wordlistPath = "dirble_wordlist.txt"
	}
	words, err := readWordlist(wordlistPath)
	if err != nil {
		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "[ERROR] Unable to find default wordlist\n")
		os.Exit(0)
	}
	var prefixes []string
	prefixes = append(prefixes, cfg.prefixes...)
	if cfg.prefixFile != "" {
		lines, err := readLinesFile(cfg.prefixFile)
		if err != nil {
			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Error reading prefix file %s: %v\n", cfg.prefixFile, err)
			os.Exit(1)
		}
		prefixes = append(prefixes, lines...)
	}
	sort.Strings(prefixes)
	prefixes = dedup(prefixes)
	var extensions []string
	extensions = append(extensions, cfg.extensions...)
	if cfg.extensionFile != "" {
		lines, err := readLinesFile(cfg.extensionFile)
		if err != nil {
			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Error reading extension file %s: %v\n", cfg.extensionFile, err)
			os.Exit(1)
		}
		extensions = append(extensions, lines...)
	}
	for i, e := range extensions {
		if e != "" && !strings.HasPrefix(e, ".") {
			extensions[i] = "." + e
		}
	}
	sort.Strings(extensions)
	extensions = dedup(extensions)
	hideRanges := parseHideLengths(cfg.hideLengths)
	var blacklistCodes []int
	for _, s := range cfg.codeBlacklist {
		c, err := strconv.Atoi(s)
		if err == nil {
			blacklistCodes = append(blacklistCodes, c)
		}
	}
	var whitelistCodes []int
	for _, s := range cfg.codeWhitelist {
		c, err := strconv.Atoi(s)
		if err == nil {
			whitelistCodes = append(whitelistCodes, c)
		}
	}
	client := buildHTTPClient(cfg)
	type UriInfo struct {
		Original  string
		Parsed    *url.URL
		BasicAuth string
	}
	var uriInfos []UriInfo
	for _, uStr := range validUris {
		parsed, _ := url.Parse(uStr)
		var basicAuth string
		if parsed.User != nil {
			user := parsed.User.Username()
			pass, _ := parsed.User.Password()
			creds := user + ":" + pass
			basicAuth = "Basic " + base64.StdEncoding.EncodeToString([]byte(creds))
		}
		if cfg.username != "" || cfg.password != "" {
			creds := cfg.username + ":" + cfg.password
			basicAuth = "Basic " + base64.StdEncoding.EncodeToString([]byte(creds))
		}
		uriInfos = append(uriInfos, UriInfo{Original: uStr, Parsed: parsed, BasicAuth: basicAuth})
	}
	var allFound []Found
	var mu sync.Mutex

	for _, uriInfo := range uriInfos {
		baseURL := uriInfo.Parsed.String()
		scanBase := strings.TrimRight(baseURL, "/") + "/"
		maxDepth := 100
		if cfg.maxRecursionDepth != nil {
			maxDepth = *cfg.maxRecursionDepth
		}
		if cfg.disableRecursion {
			maxDepth = 0
		}
		var sig NotFoundSignature
		var hasSig bool
		if !cfg.disableValidator && len(whitelistCodes) == 0 {
			s, ok, err := detectNotFound(client, scanBase, cfg.verb, cfg.userAgent, cfg.cookies, cfg.headers, cfg.username, cfg.password, uriInfo.BasicAuth, cfg.verbose)
			if err == nil && ok {
				sig = s
				hasSig = true
				if !cfg.silent {
					if s.Size != nil {
						fmt.Printf("[INFO] Detected nonexistent paths for %s are (CODE:%d|SIZE:%d)\n", scanBase, s.Code, *s.Size)
					} else if s.DiffSize != nil {
						fmt.Printf("[INFO] Detected nonexistent paths for %s are (CODE:%d|DIFF_SIZE:%d)\n", scanBase, s.Code, *s.DiffSize)
					} else {
						fmt.Printf("[INFO] Detected nonexistent paths for %s are (CODE:%d)\n", scanBase, s.Code)
					}
				}
			} else {
				if !cfg.silent {
					fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "[WARN] %s errored too often during validation, skipping scanning\n", scanBase)
				}
				continue
			}
		}
		effectiveSplit := cfg.wordlistSplit
		if cfg.maxThreads-2 > effectiveSplit {
			effectiveSplit = cfg.maxThreads - 2
			if effectiveSplit < 1 {
				effectiveSplit = 1
			}
			if effectiveSplit != cfg.wordlistSplit {
				if !cfg.silent {
					fmt.Printf("[INFO] Increasing wordlist-split for initial scan of %s to %d\n", scanBase, effectiveSplit)
				}
			}
		}
		type Task struct {
			URL   string
			Depth int
		}
		queue := []Task{{URL: scanBase, Depth: 0}}
		var queueMu sync.Mutex
		visited := make(map[string]bool)
		visited[scanBase] = true

		generateCandidates := func(base string) []string {
			var cands []string
			for _, word := range words {
				hasPlaceholder := strings.Contains(word, "%EXT%")
				if cfg.extSub {
					if hasPlaceholder {
						if !cfg.forceExtension {
							replaced := strings.ReplaceAll(word, "%EXT%", "")
							cands = append(cands, base+replaced)
							for _, ext := range extensions {
								replacedExt := strings.ReplaceAll(word, "%EXT%", ext)
								cands = append(cands, base+replacedExt)
							}
						} else {
							for _, ext := range extensions {
								replacedExt := strings.ReplaceAll(word, "%EXT%", ext)
								cands = append(cands, base+replacedExt)
							}
						}
					} else {
						if !cfg.forceExtension {
							cands = append(cands, base+word)
							for _, ext := range extensions {
								cands = append(cands, base+word+ext)
							}
						} else {
							for _, ext := range extensions {
								cands = append(cands, base+word+ext)
							}
						}
					}
				} else {
					if !cfg.forceExtension {
						cands = append(cands, base+word)
						for _, ext := range extensions {
							cands = append(cands, base+word+ext)
						}
					} else {
						for _, ext := range extensions {
							cands = append(cands, base+word+ext)
						}
					}
				}
				for _, pre := range prefixes {
					pword := pre + word
					hasPlaceholder2 := strings.Contains(pword, "%EXT%")
					if cfg.extSub {
						if hasPlaceholder2 {
							if !cfg.forceExtension {
								replaced := strings.ReplaceAll(pword, "%EXT%", "")
								cands = append(cands, base+replaced)
								for _, ext := range extensions {
									replacedExt := strings.ReplaceAll(pword, "%EXT%", ext)
									cands = append(cands, base+replacedExt)
								}
							} else {
								for _, ext := range extensions {
									replacedExt := strings.ReplaceAll(pword, "%EXT%", ext)
									cands = append(cands, base+replacedExt)
								}
							}
						} else {
							if !cfg.forceExtension {
								cands = append(cands, base+pword)
								for _, ext := range extensions {
									cands = append(cands, base+pword+ext)
								}
							} else {
								for _, ext := range extensions {
									cands = append(cands, base+pword+ext)
								}
							}
						}
					} else {
						if !cfg.forceExtension {
							cands = append(cands, base+pword)
							for _, ext := range extensions {
								cands = append(cands, base+pword+ext)
							}
						} else {
							for _, ext := range extensions {
								cands = append(cands, base+pword+ext)
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
			return cands
		}

		for len(queue) > 0 {
			queueMu.Lock()
			task := queue[0]
			queue = queue[1:]
			queueMu.Unlock()
			if cfg.maxRecursionDepth != nil && task.Depth > *cfg.maxRecursionDepth {
				continue
			}
			if maxDepth == 0 && task.Depth > 0 {
				continue
			}
			if task.Depth > maxDepth && maxDepth != 0 {
				continue
			}
			candidates := generateCandidates(task.URL)
			if cfg.verbose >= 1 && !cfg.silent {
				now := time.Now().Format("15:04:05")
				fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "%s [DEBUG] (%d) dirble::request_thread: Scanning %s\n", now, 5, task.URL)
			}
			var wg sync.WaitGroup
			type scanRes struct {
				origURL  string
				url      string
				code     int
				size     int
				redirect string
				isDir    bool
				isList   bool
				body     string
			}
			resCh := make(chan scanRes, len(candidates))
			threads := cfg.maxThreads
			if threads < 1 {
				threads = 1
			}
			sem := make(chan struct{}, threads)
			var errCount int
			var errMu sync.Mutex
			for _, candURL := range candidates {
				wg.Add(1)
				sem <- struct{}{}
				go func(u string) {
					defer wg.Done()
					defer func() { <-sem }()
					if cfg.throttle > 0 {
						time.Sleep(time.Duration(cfg.throttle) * time.Millisecond)
					}
					if cfg.verbose >= 2 {
						now := time.Now().Format("15:04:05")
						fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "%s [TRACE] (%d) dirble::request: [src/request.rs:114] Requesting %s\n", now, 5, u)
					}
					req, err := http.NewRequest(strings.ToUpper(cfg.verb), u, nil)
					if err != nil {
						errMu.Lock()
						errCount++
						errMu.Unlock()
						return
					}
					if cfg.userAgent != "" {
						req.Header.Set("User-Agent", cfg.userAgent)
					}
					if len(cfg.cookies) > 0 {
						req.Header.Set("Cookie", strings.Join(cfg.cookies, "; "))
					}
					for _, h := range cfg.headers {
						parts := strings.SplitN(h, ":", 2)
						if len(parts) == 2 {
							k := strings.TrimSpace(parts[0])
							v := strings.TrimSpace(parts[1])
							if v == "" && strings.HasSuffix(h, ";") {
								req.Header.Set(k, "")
							} else {
								req.Header.Set(k, v)
							}
						} else if strings.HasSuffix(h, ";") {
							k := strings.TrimSuffix(h, ";")
							k = strings.TrimSpace(k)
							req.Header.Set(k, "")
						}
					}
					if cfg.username != "" || cfg.password != "" {
						req.SetBasicAuth(cfg.username, cfg.password)
					} else if uriInfo.BasicAuth != "" {
						req.Header.Set("Authorization", uriInfo.BasicAuth)
					}
					resp, err := client.Do(req)
					if err != nil {
						errMu.Lock()
						errCount++
						errMu.Unlock()
						if cfg.verbose >= 1 {
							fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Curl error after requesting %s : [%v] %v\n", u, 0, err)
						} else {
							fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Curl error after requesting %s : [7] Couldn't connect to server (%v)\n", u, err)
						}
						return
					}
					body, _ := io.ReadAll(resp.Body)
					resp.Body.Close()
					size := len(body)
					code := resp.StatusCode
					redirectURL := ""
					if code >= 300 && code < 400 {
						loc := resp.Header.Get("Location")
						if loc != "" {
							baseParsed, _ := url.Parse(u)
							locParsed, err := url.Parse(loc)
							if err == nil {
								resolved := baseParsed.ResolveReference(locParsed)
								if uriInfo.Parsed.User != nil && resolved.User == nil {
									resolved.User = uriInfo.Parsed.User
								}
								redirectURL = resolved.String()
							} else {
								redirectURL = loc
							}
						}
					}
					isDir := false
					isListable := false
					dirURL := u
					origURL := u
					if (code == 301 || code == 302 || code == 307 || code == 308) && redirectURL != "" {
						uParsed, _ := url.Parse(u)
						rParsed, _ := url.Parse(redirectURL)
						if rParsed != nil && uParsed != nil {
							if rParsed.Path == uParsed.Path+"/" || (strings.HasSuffix(redirectURL, "/") && strings.TrimSuffix(u, "/") == strings.TrimSuffix(redirectURL, "/")) {
								isDir = true
							} else if strings.HasSuffix(rParsed.Path, "/") && !strings.HasSuffix(uParsed.Path, "/") {
								if strings.HasPrefix(rParsed.Path, uParsed.Path) {
									isDir = true
								}
							}
						}
						if isDir {
							dirURL = redirectURL
							req2, _ := http.NewRequest(strings.ToUpper(cfg.verb), dirURL, nil)
							if cfg.userAgent != "" {
								req2.Header.Set("User-Agent", cfg.userAgent)
							}
							if len(cfg.cookies) > 0 {
								req2.Header.Set("Cookie", strings.Join(cfg.cookies, "; "))
							}
							for _, h := range cfg.headers {
								parts := strings.SplitN(h, ":", 2)
								if len(parts) == 2 {
									k := strings.TrimSpace(parts[0])
									v := strings.TrimSpace(parts[1])
									req2.Header.Set(k, v)
								} else if strings.HasSuffix(h, ";") {
									k := strings.TrimSuffix(h, ";")
									k = strings.TrimSpace(k)
									req2.Header.Set(k, "")
								}
							}
							if cfg.username != "" || cfg.password != "" {
								req2.SetBasicAuth(cfg.username, cfg.password)
							} else if uriInfo.BasicAuth != "" {
								req2.Header.Set("Authorization", uriInfo.BasicAuth)
							}
							resp2, err := client.Do(req2)
							if err == nil {
								body2, _ := io.ReadAll(resp2.Body)
								resp2.Body.Close()
								code = resp2.StatusCode
								size = len(body2)
								body = body2
								lower := strings.ToLower(string(body))
								if strings.Contains(lower, "index of") || strings.Contains(lower, "directory listing") {
									isListable = true
								}
							}
						}
					} else {
						uParsed, _ := url.Parse(u)
						if uParsed != nil && strings.HasSuffix(uParsed.Path, "/") && code == 200 {
							isDir = true
							lower := strings.ToLower(string(body))
							if strings.Contains(lower, "index of") || strings.Contains(lower, "directory listing") {
								isListable = true
							}
						}
					}
					resCh <- scanRes{origURL: origURL, url: dirURL, code: code, size: size, redirect: redirectURL, isDir: isDir, isList: isListable, body: string(body)}
				}(candURL)
			}
			wg.Wait()
			close(resCh)
			if cfg.verbose >= 1 && !cfg.silent {
				now := time.Now().Format("15:04:05")
				fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "%s [DEBUG] (%d) dirble::output_thread: Received signal to end, generating the report\n", now, 3)
			}
			for r := range resCh {
				displayURL := r.url
				if !r.isDir && r.code >= 300 && r.code < 400 && r.redirect != "" {
					displayURL = r.origURL
				}
				if isHiddenLength(r.size, hideRanges) {
					continue
				}
				if !cfg.showHtaccess && strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(displayURL), ".ht") && r.code == 403 {
					continue
				}
				show := false
				if len(whitelistCodes) > 0 {
					for _, c := range whitelistCodes {
						if c == r.code {
							show = true
							break
						}
					}
				} else {
					blacklisted := false
					for _, c := range blacklistCodes {
						if c == r.code {
							blacklisted = true
							break
						}
					}
					if !blacklisted {
						if !cfg.disableValidator && hasSig {
							if sig.Code == r.code {
								if sig.Size != nil {
									if *sig.Size != r.size {
										show = true
									}
								} else if sig.DiffSize != nil {
									expected := len(r.url) - *sig.DiffSize
									if r.size != expected {
										show = true
									}
								} else {
								}
							} else {
								show = true
							}
						} else {
							show = true
						}
					}
				}
				if !show {
					if cfg.verbose >= 2 {
						now := time.Now().Format("15:04:05")
						fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "%s [TRACE] (%d) dirble::request_thread: [src/request_thread.rs:179] [%s]: matches Not Found condition\n", now, 5, displayURL)
					}
					continue
				}
				f := Found{
					URL:               displayURL,
					Code:              r.code,
					Size:              r.size,
					IsDirectory:       r.isDir,
					IsListable:        r.isList,
					RedirectURL:       "",
					FoundFromListable: false,
				}
				if r.code >= 300 && r.code < 400 && r.redirect != "" && !r.isDir {
					f.RedirectURL = r.redirect
				}
				mu.Lock()
				allFound = append(allFound, f)
				mu.Unlock()
				if !cfg.silent {
					var prefix string
					if r.isDir {
						if r.isList {
							prefix = "L"
						} else {
							prefix = "D"
						}
					} else {
						prefix = "+"
					}
					var line string
					if f.RedirectURL != "" {
						line = fmt.Sprintf("%s %s (CODE:%d|SIZE:%d|DEST:%s)", prefix, displayURL, r.code, r.size, f.RedirectURL)
					} else {
						line = fmt.Sprintf("%s %s (CODE:%d|SIZE:%d)", prefix, displayURL, r.code, r.size)
					}
					fmt.Println(line)
				}
				if r.isDir {
					if (r.code == 401 && !cfg.scan401) || (r.code == 403 && !cfg.scan403) {
					} else {
						queueMu.Lock()
						if !visited[displayURL] {
							visited[displayURL] = true
							if cfg.maxRecursionDepth == nil || task.Depth+1 <= *cfg.maxRecursionDepth {
								if !cfg.disableRecursion {
									if r.isList && !cfg.scanListable {
									} else {
										queue = append(queue, Task{URL: displayURL, Depth: task.Depth + 1})
									}
								}
							}
						}
						queueMu.Unlock()
					}
				}
				if cfg.scrapeListable && r.isList {
					re := regexp.MustCompile(`href=["']([^"']+)["']`)
					matches := re.FindAllStringSubmatch(r.body, -1)
					for _, m := range matches {
						href := m[1]
						if strings.HasPrefix(href, "http://") || strings.HasPrefix(href, "https://") || strings.HasPrefix(href, "//") {
							continue
						}
						var newURL string
						if strings.HasPrefix(href, "/") {
							baseParsed, _ := url.Parse(displayURL)
							newURL = fmt.Sprintf("%s://%s%s", baseParsed.Scheme, baseParsed.Host, href)
						} else {
							base := displayURL
							if !strings.HasSuffix(base, "/") {
								base += "/"
							}
							newURL = base + href
						}
						reqScrape, err := http.NewRequest(strings.ToUpper(cfg.verb), newURL, nil)
						if err != nil {
							continue
						}
						if cfg.userAgent != "" {
							reqScrape.Header.Set("User-Agent", cfg.userAgent)
						}
						if len(cfg.cookies) > 0 {
							reqScrape.Header.Set("Cookie", strings.Join(cfg.cookies, "; "))
						}
						for _, h := range cfg.headers {
							parts := strings.SplitN(h, ":", 2)
							if len(parts) == 2 {
								k := strings.TrimSpace(parts[0])
								v := strings.TrimSpace(parts[1])
								reqScrape.Header.Set(k, v)
							}
						}
						if cfg.username != "" || cfg.password != "" {
							reqScrape.SetBasicAuth(cfg.username, cfg.password)
						} else if uriInfo.BasicAuth != "" {
							reqScrape.Header.Set("Authorization", uriInfo.BasicAuth)
						}
						respScrape, err := client.Do(reqScrape)
						if err != nil {
							continue
						}
						bodyScrape, _ := io.ReadAll(respScrape.Body)
						respScrape.Body.Close()
						sizeScrape := len(bodyScrape)
						codeScrape := respScrape.StatusCode
						redirectScrape := ""
						if codeScrape >= 300 && codeScrape < 400 {
							loc := respScrape.Header.Get("Location")
							if loc != "" {
								baseP, _ := url.Parse(newURL)
								locP, err := url.Parse(loc)
								if err == nil {
									resolved := baseP.ResolveReference(locP)
									if uriInfo.Parsed.User != nil && resolved.User == nil {
										resolved.User = uriInfo.Parsed.User
									}
									redirectScrape = resolved.String()
								} else {
									redirectScrape = loc
								}
							}
						}
						fScrape := Found{
							URL:               newURL,
							Code:              codeScrape,
							Size:              sizeScrape,
							IsDirectory:       strings.HasSuffix(newURL, "/"),
							IsListable:        false,
							RedirectURL:       redirectScrape,
							FoundFromListable: true,
						}
						showScrape := true
						if isHiddenLength(sizeScrape, hideRanges) {
							showScrape = false
						}
						if !cfg.showHtaccess && strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(newURL), ".ht") && codeScrape == 403 {
							showScrape = false
						}
						if len(whitelistCodes) > 0 {
							foundCode := false
							for _, c := range whitelistCodes {
								if c == codeScrape {
									foundCode = true
									break
								}
							}
							if !foundCode {
								showScrape = false
							}
						} else {
							for _, c := range blacklistCodes {
								if c == codeScrape {
									showScrape = false
									break
								}
							}
							if showScrape && !cfg.disableValidator && hasSig {
								if sig.Code == codeScrape {
									if sig.Size != nil {
										if *sig.Size == sizeScrape {
											showScrape = false
										}
									} else if sig.DiffSize != nil {
										expected := len(newURL) - *sig.DiffSize
										if sizeScrape == expected {
											showScrape = false
										}
									} else {
										showScrape = false
									}
								}
							}
						}
						if showScrape {
							mu.Lock()
							allFound = append(allFound, fScrape)
							mu.Unlock()
							if !cfg.silent {
								var pre string
								if fScrape.IsDirectory {
									pre = "D"
								} else {
									pre = "+"
								}
								var line string
								if fScrape.RedirectURL != "" && !fScrape.IsDirectory {
									line = fmt.Sprintf("%s %s (CODE:%d|SIZE:%d|DEST:%s)", pre, newURL, codeScrape, sizeScrape, fScrape.RedirectURL)
								} else {
									line = fmt.Sprintf("%s %s (CODE:%d|SIZE:%d)", pre, newURL, codeScrape, sizeScrape)
								}
								fmt.Println(line)
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}

	// For silent mode, print report at end if allFound non-empty?
	if cfg.silent {
		for _, ff := range allFound {
			var prefix string
			if ff.IsDirectory {
				if ff.IsListable {
					prefix = "L"
				} else {
					prefix = "D"
				}
			} else {
				prefix = "+"
			}
			var line string
			if ff.RedirectURL != "" {
				line = fmt.Sprintf("%s %s (CODE:%d|SIZE:%d|DEST:%s)", prefix, ff.URL, ff.Code, ff.Size, ff.RedirectURL)
			} else {
				line = fmt.Sprintf("%s %s (CODE:%d|SIZE:%d)", prefix, ff.URL, ff.Code, ff.Size)
			}
			fmt.Println(line)
		}
	}

	if cfg.outputFile != "" {
		if len(validUris) > 0 {
			_ = writeTxtReport(cfg.outputFile, validUris[0], allFound)
		}
	}
	if cfg.jsonFile != "" {
		_ = writeJsonReport(cfg.jsonFile, allFound)
	}
	if cfg.xmlFile != "" {
		_ = writeXmlReport(cfg.xmlFile, allFound)
	}
	if cfg.outputAll != "" {
		base := strings.TrimRight(cfg.outputAll, "/")
		if len(validUris) > 0 {
			_ = writeTxtReport(base+".txt", validUris[0], allFound)
		}
		_ = writeJsonReport(base+".json", allFound)
		_ = writeXmlReport(base+".xml", allFound)
	}
}
GO
go build -o executable main.go 2>&1 && echo built
./executable --help 2>&1 | head -n 2
./executable -V 2>&1
"}

		wordlistSplit: 3,

	var positional []string
	i := 0

					cfg.uris = append(cfg.uris, line)
				}
			}
			i++
			continue
		}
		if strings.HasPrefix(a, "--url-file=") {
			fpath := strings.TrimPrefix(a, "--url-file=")
			data, err := os.ReadFile(fpath)
			if err != nil {
				fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Error reading file %s: %v\n", fpath, err)
				os.Exit(1)
			}
			lines := strings.Split(string(data), "\n")
			for _, line := range lines {
				line = strings.TrimSpace(line)
				if line != "" {
					cfg.uris = append(cfg.uris, line)
				}
			}
			i++
			continue
		}
		if !strings.HasPrefix(a, "-") {
			positional = append(positional, a)
			i++
			continue
		}
		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "error: unexpected argument '%s' found\n\n  tip: to pass '%s' as a value, use '-- %s'\n\nUsage: executable [OPTIONS] <uri|--uri-file <uri-file>|--uri <uri>>\n\nFor more information, try '--help'.\n", a, a, a)
		os.Exit(2)
	}
	return cfg, positional, nil
}

func readWordlist(p string) ([]string, error) {
	data, err := os.ReadFile(p)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	lines := strings.Split(string(data), "\n")
	var res []string
	for _, l := range lines {
		l = strings.TrimRight(l, "\r")
		t := strings.TrimSpace(l)
		if t == "" {
			continue
		}
		if strings.HasPrefix(t, "#") {
			continue
		}
		res = append(res, t)
	}
	return res, nil
}

func readLinesFile(p string) ([]string, error) {
	data, err := os.ReadFile(p)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	lines := strings.Split(string(data), "\n")
	var res []string
	for _, l := range lines {
		l = strings.TrimRight(l, "\r")
		t := strings.TrimSpace(l)
		if t == "" {
			continue
		}
		res = append(res, t)
	}
	return res, nil
}

	Code     int
